title: Benchmarking and Improving Monitors for Out-Of-Distribution Alignment Failure in LLMs
summary: Many safety and alignment failures of large language models (LLMs) occur due to out-of-distribution (OOD) situations: unusual prompt or response patterns that are unforeseen by model developers. We systematically study whether LLM monitoring pipelines can detect these OOD alignment failures by introducing a benchmark called Misalignment Out Of Distribution (MOOD). It is difficult to find failures that are truly OOD for off-the-shelf models trained on vast safety datasets. We sidestep this by including a restricted training set in MOOD that we use to train our own monitors, as well as seven test sets with diverse alignment failures that are outside the training distribution. Using MOOD, we find that guard models (safety classifiers) often fail to generalize OOD. To fix this, we propose combining guard models with OOD detectors. We test four types of OOD detectors and find that a combination of a guard model with Mahalanobis distance and perplexity-based OOD detectors can improve recall from 39% to 45%. We also establish positive scaling trends across model scales for monitors that combine a guard model and OOD detector; we find that incorporating OOD detection into monitoring achieves a higher recall gain than using a guard model with 20 times more parameters. Our work suggests that OOD detection should be a crucial component of LLM monitoring and provides a foundation for further work on this important problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOOD基准，研究LLM监控管道能否检测到分布外（OOD）对齐失败，并提出将守卫模型与OOD检测器结合的方法，显著提升召回率。
AI.motivation: 许多LLM的安全和对齐失败发生在分布外（OOD）场景中，即模型开发者未预料到的异常提示或响应模式。现有监控系统对这些OOD对齐失败的检测能力不足，亟需系统性研究。
AI.method: 构建MOOD基准，包含受限训练集和七个测试集（覆盖多种OOD对齐失败）；提出将守卫模型（安全分类器）与OOD检测器（马氏距离、困惑度等四种类型）结合，构建监控管道。
AI.result: 守卫模型在OOD场景下泛化能力差；结合守卫模型与马氏距离+困惑度OOD检测器可将召回率从39%提升至45%；OOD检测带来的召回增益相当于使用20倍参数量的守卫模型。
AI.conclusion: OOD检测应成为LLM监控的关键组件，为后续研究奠定基础。

title: TO-Agents: A Multi-Agent AI Pipeline for Preference-Guided Topology Optimization
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the ASME 2026 International Design Engineering Technical Conferences (IDETC2026)
summary: Topology optimization can generate efficient structures, but designers often must manually translate qualitative intent, such as desired visual style, product experience, or manufacturability into solver settings that are not directly tied to those preferences. We present TO-Agents, a multi-agent AI framework that connects natural-language design intent with iterative topology optimization. The framework converts a human-provided problem description into validated solver inputs, runs a topology optimization solver, renders the resulting 3D topology, and uses multi-view vision-language reasoning with an independent judge agent to critique each result and revise solver parameters. We evaluate the framework on two long-horizon design tasks: a cantilever beam benchmark and a phone-stand product design. In both tasks, the designer specifies an aesthetic preference for hierarchically branched structures inspired by natural tree morphologies, and the system performs four revision cycles across ten independent replicates. TO-Agents produces at least one preference-aligned design in 60% of trials for each case study, corresponding to up to 6x more successful trials than an ablated pipeline without visual or historical feedback. Judge scores and human evaluations show that the pipeline can identify effective parameter levers, recover from poor revisions, and expand design exploration. A manufacturing agent further post-processes top-ranked designs for additive manufacturing, enabling end-to-end intent-to-prototype design. We also identify failure modes, including overshooting, selective memory, misplaced tools, and incorrect parameter reasoning. These results suggest that agentic topology optimization can shift designers from low-level parameter tuning toward higher-level specification of form and function, while highlighting safeguards needed for reliable autonomous engineering design.

AI.result: 在悬臂梁基准和手机支架两个任务中，TO-Agents在60%的试验中至少产生一个符合偏好的设计，成功试验次数比无视觉/历史反馈的消融基线高出6倍。
AI.conclusion: 智能体拓扑优化能将设计师从底层参数调优转向高层形式和功能规范，但需要安全机制确保可靠的自主工程设计。

title: The Shape of Testimony: A Scalable Framework for Oral History Archive Comparison
summary: Researchers in Holocaust studies have often distinguished between two styles of oral survivor testimony: the USC Shoah Foundation's interviews tend to follow a structured, interviewer-guided format, whereas the Yale Fortunoff Video Archive generally favors a more free-form, open-ended style. This distinction has influenced both scholarly research and the development of later archives. In this study, we critically examine that claim by conducting a large-scale computational analysis of more than 1,600 testimonies from both collections. Leveraging discourse segmentation, topic modeling, and large language model (LLM) based analysis, we quantify the "structuredness" level of testimonies through topic coherence, interviewer-survivor dynamics, and the distribution of question types. Our results generally corroborate the structural differences identified in earlier research, while also revealing significant overlaps between the collections, both within individual interviews and across common narrative patterns. This complicates the simple "structured vs. free-form" dichotomy often applied to these oral histories. Beyond revisiting a foundational claim in Holocaust studies, our work provides a scalable, replicable framework for comparative corpus analysis. As a proof of concept, it suggests broader applications for digital oral history, narrative analysis, and the design of citizen-science annotation platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模计算分析（1600+证词），使用话语分割、主题建模和LLM，检验了USC Shoah Foundation（结构化访谈）与Yale Fortunoff Video Archive（自由形式访谈）之间的传统二元区分，发现两者虽有结构差异但存在显著重叠，挑战了简单的"结构化vs自由式"二分法。
AI.motivation: 大屠杀研究中长期存在一种区分：USC证词结构化、Yale证词自由式。作者旨在通过大规模计算分析批判性地检验这一传统论断，以更精确地理解两种档案的实际差异。

AI.conclusion: 本研究不仅重新审视了大屠杀研究中的一个基础性论断，还提供了一个可扩展、可复制的比较语料库分析框架，对数字口述历史、叙事分析和公民科学标注平台设计具有更广泛的应用前景。

title: MindLoom: Composing Thought Modes for Frontier-Level Reasoning Data Synthesis
comment: Work in Progress. Comments: 27 pages, 4 figures, preprint
summary: Although LLMs have made substantial progress in reasoning, systematically producing frontier-level reasoning data remains difficult. Existing synthesis methods often have limited visibility into the structural factors that govern problem difficulty, which can result in narrow diversity and unstable difficulty control. In this work, we view the difficulty of a reasoning problem as arising from the accumulation of atomic knowledge-reasoning transformations, which we term thought modes. Building on this perspective, we propose MindLoom, a framework for synthesizing frontier-level reasoning data through compositional thought mode engineering. Given a collection of hard problems with verified solutions, MindLoom first decomposes those solutions into thought mode chains that reveal each problem's construction logic. It then trains a retrieval model that matches problem states to compatible thought modes, providing guidance on which reasoning challenges to introduce during synthesis. New problems are composed by iteratively applying retrieved thought modes to seed questions, with distribution-aligned sampling to encourage diverse reasoning coverage. Finally, a rollout-based judging stage labels generated questions by difficulty and supplies judged-correct responses for supervised fine-tuning. We evaluate MindLoom on nine benchmarks covering five STEM disciplines and four mathematical reasoning tasks across multiple model families and sizes. Models fine-tuned on MindLoom-generated data achieves favorable performances over base models, distillation, and external-data baselines across the reported benchmarks. Ablation studies indicate the contribution of each component, and further analysis suggests that MindLoom covers a broad range of reasoning patterns while maintaining useful difficulty control. We have open-sourced our implementation at https://github.com/EachSheep/MindLoom.

AI.tldr: MindLoom是一个通过组合性思维模式工程合成前沿推理数据的框架。它先将困难问题的解决方案分解为思维模式链，再训练检索模型匹配问题状态与思维模式，最后通过迭代应用检索到的思维模式生成新问题，并利用基于rollout的评判阶段标注难度和提供正确答案。
AI.motivation: 现有推理数据合成方法对决定问题难度的结构因素可见性有限，导致数据多样性不足且难度控制不稳定。需要一种能够系统理解问题难度构成、可控生成高质量推理数据的方法。
AI.method: 1) 将推理问题难度视为原子知识-推理变换（思维模式）的累积；2) 将困难问题的解决方案分解为思维模式链；3) 训练检索模型匹配问题状态与兼容思维模式；4) 通过迭代应用检索到的思维模式组合新问题，配合分布对齐采样；5) 基于rollout的评判阶段标注难度并提供正确响应用于监督微调。
AI.result: 在9个基准测试（涵盖5个STEM学科和4个数学推理任务）上，MindLoom微调的模型在多个模型系列和规模上均优于基模型、蒸馏和外部数据基线。消融实验验证了各组件的贡献，分析表明MindLoom覆盖广泛推理模式并维持有效的难度控制。
AI.conclusion: MindLoom通过思维模式的组合性工程，实现了对推理数据难度的可解释控制和多样化覆盖，为合成前沿级推理数据提供了一种有效且可控的方法论。

title: AOP-Wiki EMOD 3.0: Data Model Expansions and Content Evaluation Framework for Using Agentic AI to Improve Integration between AOPs and New Approach Methodologies (NAMs)
comment: 7 Figures and 3 Supplemental Figures
summary: Adverse Outcome Pathways (AOP) are logic models that causally link biological mechanisms that can be measured in a lab to adverse outcomes, relevant to chemical regulatory endpoints. AOPs contextualize new approach methodologies (NAMs), in vitro and in silico methods used as alternatives to animal testing and the sequential events in an AOP serve as multi-scale models spanning biological scales. The AOP-Wiki serves as the global repository for AOPs. While the AOP-Wiki has played a central role in AOP expansion over the past decade, constraints within the current data model and application infrastructure limit the AOP-Wiki from supporting continued AOP growth and evolution. Yet, the transformative power of agentic AI has re-invigorated AOP-Wiki data modernization efforts at a time when core AOP principles can be harnessed to inform use of AI for aggregating and structuring AOP-relevant information. Seizing upon this momentum, we present AOP-Wiki EMOD 3.0, the third in a series of evidence model prototypes, which concretely demonstrates data model expansions and our vision for how the AOP-Wiki might be transformed to better serve regulatory science and emergent use of AOPs in biomedical and One Health contexts. We aim to lay a foundation to support computationally-generated AOPs and quantitative AOPs (qAOPs) by focussing on solutions for AOP-Wiki internal quality improvement, evidence structuring to enhance AOP FAIRness and AI-readiness, and improved integration between the AOP framework and NAMs to better serve next generation risk assessment.

AI.method: 采用agentic AI技术驱动数据现代化，设计了AOP-Wiki EMOD 3.0证据模型原型，重点进行数据模型扩展、内部质量改进、证据结构化以增强FAIR原则和AI就绪性，并改进AOP框架与NAMs之间的整合。
AI.result: 提出了一个具体的证据模型原型，展示了数据模型扩展方案，能够支持计算生成的AOP、定量AOP，并提升AOP-Wiki在监管科学、生物医学和One Health场景中的可用性。
AI.conclusion: AOP-Wiki EMOD 3.0为AOP知识库的现代化转型奠定了基础，通过AI驱动和数据模型创新，有望更好地服务下一代风险评估。

title: Investigating Concept Alignment Using Implausible Category Members
summary: Developing AI systems with a human-like understanding of everyday concepts is a key step towards developing safe, reliable systems whose behavior makes sense to humans. When probing concept understanding, asking questions about plausible category members (e.g., "Is a car a vehicle?") is likely to recall patterns in the model's vast training data. We pursue an alternative strategy, characterizing the boundaries of conceptual categories by asking about implausible category members (e.g., "Is an olive a vehicle?") to probe the kind of concept-level knowledge we take for granted in fellow humans. We characterize concept boundaries for a set of fundamental concepts by studying AI systems' assignments of objects to superordinate categories from a classic psychological study by Rosch and Mervis, as well as their assignments of the same objects to mismatched superordinate categories. We compare these assignments to those made by human participants on the full range of within-category and cross-category assignment tasks. Our results reveal a range of concepts for which which models differ in meaningful and surprising ways from humans, including treating "words" as belonging to categories like "vehicles" and "clothing," identifying several "vegetable" category members as "fruit," and assigning exemplars from non-weapon categories to the "weapons" category. We also demonstrate how these instances of concept misalignment translate into problematic downstream behavior with implications for AI safety.

AI.tldr: 本文通过询问AI系统关于不合理类别成员（如“橄榄是车辆吗？”）的问题，探索AI对概念边界的理解，并与人类判断进行比较，发现AI在基本概念分类上存在显著且令人惊讶的偏差，这些偏差可能导致有问题的下游行为，对AI安全构成影响。

AI.result: AI系统在多个概念上与人类存在显著差异，包括将"words"归类为"vehicles"和"clothing"，将一些"蔬菜"类别成员识别为"水果"，以及将非武器类别的示例分配到"weapons"类别。
AI.conclusion: AI系统的概念边界与人类存在系统性偏差，这些概念对齐问题会转化为有问题的下游行为，对AI安全构成潜在风险。

title: The Impact of AI Usage and Informativeness on Skill Development in Logical Reasoning
comment: Accepted at Hybrid Human Artificial Intelligence (HHAI) 2026
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is being increasingly integrated into human problem-solving, yet its effects on individual skill development remain unclear. We examine how both AI usage and informativeness can shape learning in the context of a controlled logical reasoning task with on-demand access to AI assistance. We find that greater AI usage is associated with weaker skill development: heavy AI users underperform relative to comparable peers, whereas light AI users perform similarly to matched users who do not use AI. We also find in our study that these patterns are mediated by AI informativeness. Low-information AI neither improves immediate performance nor preserves performance after AI assistance is removed, and is linked to weaker learning overall. On the other hand, high-information AI was found to improve short-run performance without reducing post-AI outcomes on average in our experiments, but with heterogeneous effects. Our findings in general suggest that AI can, depending on context, either complement human skill development by amplifying independent reasoning or can act as a substitute that undermines such reasoning, with the implication that regulating AI access and usage will be important for promoting skill development in the presence of AI assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI辅助对逻辑推理任务中人类技能发展的影响，发现重度AI使用会削弱个人技能发展，而AI的信息含量（低信息 vs 高信息）在其中起关键调节作用。
AI.motivation: 虽然AI越来越多地融入人类问题解决过程，但AI对个人技能发展的影响尚不明确，需要系统研究AI使用程度和信息含量对学习效果的作用。
AI.method: 通过受控逻辑推理任务实验，向被试提供按需AI辅助，比较不同AI使用强度和信息含量条件下的表现差异。
AI.result: 重度AI使用与较弱的技能发展相关；低信息AI既不能改善即时表现也无法保留后AI表现；高信息AI能改善短期表现且不降低后AI表现，但存在异质性效应。
AI.conclusion: AI既可以通过增强独立推理来补充人类技能发展，也可能作为替代品削弱这种推理，监管AI的访问和使用对促进技能发展至关重要。
idea_en: A method for dynamic AI assistance level adjustment based on user's historical problem-solving performance and cognitive load, wherein the system gradually reduces AI informativeness to promote independent reasoning skill development.
A system for AI-assisted learning that classifies user interaction patterns into heavy/light usage categories and intervenes by limiting AI output detail when substitution behavior is detected.

A feedback mechanism that quantifies AI informativeness (high vs low information content) and provides real-time recommendations to balance immediate task performance with long-term skill acquisition.
An AI training system with a progressive withdrawal module that gradually removes AI assistance to transition users from AI-dependent to independent problem-solving.
A method for evaluating the impact of AI assistance on human skill development by comparing performance metrics before, during, and after AI access periods across different informativeness levels.
idea_ch: 一种基于用户历史问题解决表现和认知负荷动态调整AI辅助信息含量的方法，系统逐步降低AI信息量以促进独立推理技能的发展。
一种AI辅助学习系统，通过将用户交互模式分类为重度和轻度使用类别，并在检测到替代行为时限制AI输出细节以进行干预。
一种量化AI信息含量（高信息vs低信息）并提供实时建议的反馈机制，以平衡即时任务表现与长期技能获取。
一种具有渐进式退出模块的AI训练系统，逐步移除AI辅助以帮助用户从AI依赖过渡到独立解决问题。
一种通过比较不同信息含量水平下AI使用前、使用中和使用后的表现指标，评估AI辅助对人类技能发展影响的方法。

title: Latent-space Attacks for Refusal Evasion in Language Models
summary: Safety-aligned language models are trained to refuse harmful requests, yet refusal behavior can be suppressed by steering their internal representations. Existing methods do so by ablating a refusal direction from model activations, aiming to remove refusal from the model's residual stream. Despite their empirical success, these methods lack a principled account of the latent-space transformation they induce and why it suppresses refusal. In this work, we recast refusal suppression as a latent-space evasion attack against linear probes trained to separate refused from answered prompts. Under this view, prior work's difference-in-means direction naturally defines such a probe, and its ablation is exactly a projection onto its decision boundary, i.e., a minimum-confidence evasion attack. This perspective not only explains the empirical success of prior work but also admits a key limitation: evasion stops at the decision boundary, motivating the need to push representations further into the compliant region, i.e., where the model answers. We leverage this by proposing a Controlled Latent-space Evasion attack that projects representations past the boundary with an optimized confidence. We achieve state-of-the-art attack success rate across 15 instruction-tuned, multimodal, and reasoning models, outperforming existing refusal-ablation baselines and specialized jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文将有安全对齐的语言模型的拒绝行为抑制重新定义为潜在空间逃避攻击，提出受控潜在空间逃避攻击（CLE），通过将表示投影越过决策边界来获得更优的越狱效果。
AI.motivation: 现有拒绝抑制方法（如消减拒绝方向）虽有效但缺乏理论解释，且仅能将表示推到决策边界（即最小置信度攻击），无法充分进入"合规区域"。
AI.method: 将拒绝抑制重新定义为对线性探针的潜在空间逃避攻击，提出受控潜在空间逃避攻击（CLE），通过将表示投影越过决策边界并用优化置信度控制攻击强度。
AI.result: 在15个指令微调、多模态和推理模型上实现了最先进的攻击成功率，优于现有拒绝消减基线和专用越狱攻击方法。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝消减的本质是潜在空间逃避攻击，将表示推过决策边界可以获得更强的拒绝抑制效果。
idea_en: A controlled latent-space evasion attack method for suppressing refusal behavior in safety-aligned language models, which projects internal representations past a linear probe's decision boundary rather than stopping at it.
A framework for recasting refusal suppression as latent-space evasion attacks against linear probes, providing theoretical grounding for why ablation of refusal directions works.
An optimized confidence control mechanism for latent-space evasion attacks that determines how far past the decision boundary to push representations, enabling tunable attack strength.
A method for constructing refusal probes from difference-in-means directions of model activations for answered vs. refused prompts.
A projection-based attack that transforms model internal representations to the compliant region (where models answer) by crossing the decision boundary of a refusal probe.
idea_ch: 一种受控潜在空间逃避攻击方法，通过将安全对齐语言模型的内部表示投影越过线性探针的决策边界（而非停在边界处），来抑制模型的拒绝行为。
一个将拒绝抑制重新定义为针对线性探针的潜在空间逃避攻击的理论框架，为消减拒绝方向为何有效提供了理论依据。
一种优化的置信度控制机制，用于确定将表示推向决策边界多远的距离，从而实现可调节的攻击强度。
一种从模型激活的'已回答vs已拒绝'提示的均值差方向构建拒绝探针的方法。
一种基于投影的攻击方法，通过跨越拒绝探针的决策边界，将模型内部表示转换到合规区域（即模型会回答的区域）。

title: AttuneBench: A Conversation-Based Benchmark for LLM Emotional Intelligence
summary: Emotional intelligence (EI), the ability to perceive, understand, and respond appropriately to others' emotional states, is central to human communication, and increasingly important to assess as LLMs assume conversational roles in everyday life. Existing EI benchmarks rely on synthetic prompts, single-turn cases, or third-party annotation. These approaches do not directly measure how models infer and respond to a participant's emotional state over the course of a real conversation. We introduce AttuneBench, a benchmark grounded in 200 genuine multi-turn human-model conversations in which participants conversed with anonymized LLMs and provided turn-by-turn annotations of their emotional state, the model's behavior, and their preferred responses. Across 11 evaluated models, we find that model rankings on emotion recognition, behavioral classification, preference prediction, and judged response quality are largely independent, indicating that emotionally intelligent behavior decomposes into separable capabilities. Preference alignment and response-quality judgments are substantially more model-discriminating than emotion-label accuracy. These results indicate that emotionally intelligent behavior requires predicting what kind of response a specific user wants in context, a distinction that aggregate scoring can obscure and that single-turn or synthetic formats cannot directly capture across turns. AttuneBench provides a framework for assessing each of these capabilities and for diagnosing model-specific strengths and failure modes in emotionally salient conversation.

AI.tldr: AttuneBench是一个基于200场真实人机多轮对话的情感智能评估基准，发现模型在情感识别、行为分类、偏好预测和响应质量判断等能力上相互独立，其中偏好对齐和响应质量比情感标签准确性更能区分模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有情感智能基准依赖合成提示、单轮案例或第三方标注，无法直接衡量模型在真实多轮对话中推断和回应用户情感状态的能力。
AI.method: 收集200场真实的多轮人机对话，参与者与匿名LLM进行对话，并提供逐轮的情绪状态、模型行为以及偏好回应标注，构建AttuneBench基准。
AI.result: 对11个模型评估发现，情感识别、行为分类、偏好预测和响应质量判断的排名基本独立；偏好对齐和响应质量判断比情感标签准确性更具模型区分度。
AI.conclusion: 情感智能行为可分解为可分离的能力维度，需要在具体上下文中预测用户想要的响应类型，而单轮或合成格式无法直接跨轮次捕捉这种区别。
idea_en: A multi-turn emotion annotation framework that collects real-time, turn-by-turn emotional state annotations from human participants during genuine conversations with LLMs, enabling dynamic emotion tracking across conversation turns.

A method for decomposing emotional intelligence into separable capabilities (emotion recognition, behavioral classification, preference prediction, response quality judgment) and evaluating each independently using real conversational data.
A preference alignment scoring mechanism that measures how well a model predicts the specific type of response a user wants in a given conversational context, based on turn-by-turn user annotations.
A behavioral classification system for LLM responses in emotionally salient conversations, categorizing model behaviors based on how they respond to user emotional states in multi-turn interactions.

A framework for diagnosing model-specific strengths and failure modes in emotionally salient conversations by analyzing the relationship between emotion recognition accuracy and response quality judgment.
idea_ch: 一种多轮情感标注框架，在人与LLM的真实对话过程中，实时逐轮收集参与者的情感状态标注，实现跨对话轮次的动态情感追踪。
一种将情感智能分解为可分离能力维度（情感识别、行为分类、偏好预测、响应质量判断）并利用真实对话数据独立评估各维度的方法。
一种偏好对齐评分机制，基于用户逐轮标注，量化模型在特定对话上下文中预测用户期望响应类型的能力。
一种面向情感敏感对话的LLM响应行为分类系统，根据模型在多轮交互中回应用户情感状态的方式对模型行为进行分类。
一种诊断模型在情感敏感对话中特定优势和失败模式的框架，通过分析情感识别准确率与响应质量判断之间的关系来实现。

title: SMDD-Bench: Can LLMs Solve Real-World Small Molecule Drug Design Tasks?
summary: LLM agents have incredible potential for scientific discovery applications. However, the performance of LLM agents on real-world, small molecule drug design (SMDD) tasks across diverse chemistries and targets is unclear. Current evaluation methods are either ad hoc, too simple for real-world discovery, limited in scale, or restricted to single-turn question answering. In effort to standardize the evaluation of LLM agents on small molecule design, we introduce SMDD-Bench, a challenging, multi-turn, long-horizon agentic benchmark consisting of 502 guaranteed-solvable task instances spanning 5 task types: 2D Pharmacophore Identification, Interaction Point Discovery, Scaffold Hopping, Lead Optimization, and Fragment Assembly. SMDD-Bench tasks span a wide region of chemical space and involve 102 unique protein targets. Completely solving the benchmark would require having strong chemical and biological reasoning and 3D intuition, understanding specialized tool use, and displaying planning expertise over a limited number of oracle calls. We benchmark 7 frontier open and closed source LLMs and find even the most performant LLM, GPT5.4, solves only 40.2\% of tasks. We hope SMDD-Bench provides a standardized testbed to invigorate the field towards training and evaluating LLM agents for fully autonomous computational drug design. We host a public leaderboard at smddbench.com .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SMDD-Bench，一个用于评估LLM智能体在小分子药物设计（SMDD）任务上表现的多轮、长程基准测试集，包含502个可解任务实例，涵盖5种任务类型和102个蛋白质靶点。实验表明，即使性能最好的GPT5.4也只解决了40.2%的任务。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏一个标准化、具有挑战性且可扩展的基准测试来评估LLM智能体在真实世界小分子药物设计任务上的表现，现有评估方法要么过于简单、要么规模有限、要么局限于单轮问答。
AI.method: 构建了SMDD-Bench基准测试集，包含502个保证可解的任务实例，涵盖5种任务类型（2D药效团识别、相互作用点发现、骨架跃迁、先导化合物优化、片段组装），涉及102个独特蛋白质靶点，评估需要化学/生物学推理、3D直觉、专业工具使用和规划能力。
AI.result: 对7个前沿开闭源LLM进行基准测试，性能最好的GPT5.4仅解决40.2%的任务，表明当前LLM在自主药物设计方面仍有巨大提升空间。
AI.conclusion: SMDD-Bench为训练和评估LLM智能体在全自动计算药物设计中的能力提供了一个标准化测试平台，并公开了排行榜以推动该领域发展。
idea_en: A multi-turn, long-horizon agentic benchmark (SMDD-Bench) for standardized evaluation of LLM agents on small molecule drug design tasks across 5 task types with guaranteed-solvable instances.
A 2D pharmacophore identification task design that requires LLM agents to reason about chemical features and spatial relationships from 2D molecular representations.
An interaction point discovery task that evaluates LLM agents' 3D intuition and ability to identify protein-ligand interaction hotspots.
A scaffold hopping evaluation methodology that tests LLM agents' ability to propose novel molecular scaffolds while maintaining desired biological activity.
A lead optimization task framework that requires LLM agents to iteratively improve molecular properties through limited oracle calls with planning expertise.
A fragment assembly task design that challenges LLM agents to combine molecular fragments into drug-like molecules with specific binding properties.
A benchmark methodology incorporating 102 unique protein targets spanning diverse chemical space to comprehensively evaluate LLM agents' generalization capabilities across different drug targets.
An oracle call budgeting mechanism integrated into the benchmark to evaluate LLM agents' planning and resource allocation expertise during multi-turn molecular design.
A public leaderboard system (smddbench.com) for standardized comparison and tracking of LLM agent performance on autonomous computational drug design tasks.
idea_ch: 一种用于LLM智能体在多轮长程小分子药物设计任务上标准化评估的基准测试系统（SMDD-Bench），包含5种任务类型和保证可解的任务实例。
一种2D药效团识别任务设计方法，要求LLM智能体从二维分子表示中推理化学特征和空间关系。
一种相互作用点发现任务，用于评估LLM智能体的3D直觉以及识别蛋白质-配体相互作用热点的能力。
一种骨架跃迁评估方法，测试LLM智能体在保持生物活性的同时提出新颖分子骨架的能力。
一种先导化合物优化任务框架，要求LLM智能体在有限的oracle调用次数下通过规划能力迭代优化分子性质。
一种片段组装任务设计，挑战LLM智能体将分子片段组合成具有特定结合特性的类药分子。
一种涵盖102个独特蛋白质靶点的基准测试方法，用于全面评估LLM智能体在不同药物靶点上的泛化能力。
一种集成在基准测试中的oracle调用预算机制，用于评估LLM智能体在多轮分子设计中的规划和资源分配能力。
一种用于标准化比较和追踪LLM智能体在自主计算药物设计任务上性能的公开排行榜系统。

title: Who Uses AI? Platforms, Workforce, and AI Exposure
summary: A growing literature uses artificial intelligence platform conversation logs to measure occupation exposure. We show that these scores partly measure platform user base rather than the workforce. Holding outcome, sample, controls, and estimator fixed while varying only the platform input changes the post-ChatGPT employment coefficient by a factor of 1.9, and within-vendor consumer-versus-enterprise channels produce estimates that disagree in sign. Reweighting to Bureau of Labor Statistics workforce shares attenuates estimates by 42 to 93 percent. We formalize the non-classical measurement error, derive probability limits and partial-identification bounds for employment elasticities. The bias understates substitution more than augmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示基于AI平台对话日志的职业暴露度测量存在系统性偏差：测量结果反映的是平台用户构成而非实际劳动力市场结构，不同平台输入会导致估计系数相差1.9倍且符号相反，经BLS劳动力权重调整后估计值衰减42-93%。
AI.motivation: 现有研究广泛使用AI平台（如ChatGPT）的对话日志来度量各职业对AI的暴露度，但这类度量可能受到平台用户群体偏差的影响，而非真实反映劳动力市场结构。作者旨在揭示这一测量误差的来源、量化其影响，并提出修正方法。
AI.method: 1) 固定结果变量、样本、控制变量和估计方法，仅改变平台输入（不同版本的AI平台数据）进行比较实验；2) 区分同一供应商内的消费者端与企业端渠道；3) 使用BLS劳动力份额进行重加权修正；4) 构建非经典测量误差的理论模型，推导概率极限和部分识别边界。
AI.result: 1) 不同平台输入导致ChatGPT后就业弹性系数相差1.9倍；2) 消费者端与企业端估计结果符号相反；3) BLS重加权使估计值衰减42-93%；4) 测量误差导致对AI替代效应的低估程度大于对增强效应的低估。
AI.conclusion: 基于AI平台对话日志的职业暴露度测量存在非经典测量误差，严重依赖于平台用户群体结构而非实际劳动力特征。研究者需谨慎使用此类度量，并建议采用劳动力市场代表性权重进行校正，否则会系统性低估AI对就业的替代效应。
idea_en: A method for correcting platform user base bias in AI exposure measurements by reweighting AI platform conversation log data using Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) workforce share statistics to obtain labor-market-representative occupational exposure scores.

A system for detecting non-classical measurement error in AI-derived occupational exposure metrics by comparing estimates across different platform input versions (consumer vs. enterprise channels, different AI model versions) while holding outcome, sample, controls, and estimator fixed.

A partial identification framework for bounding employment elasticities under non-classical measurement error in AI platform-based occupational exposure measures, accounting for asymmetric biases between substitution and augmentation effects.

A method for quantifying the divergence between platform user demographics and workforce demographics in AI exposure studies, using platform-specific user base characteristics as a calibration factor for exposure scores.
idea_ch: 一种基于BLS劳动力份额权重对AI平台对话日志数据进行重加权校正的方法，用于消除平台用户群体偏差，获得具有劳动力市场代表性的职业暴露度评分。
一种检测AI衍生职业暴露度指标中非经典测量误差的系统，通过固定结果、样本、控制变量和估计方法，比较不同平台输入版本（消费者端vs企业端、不同AI模型版本）的估计结果差异。
一种在AI平台职业暴露度测量存在非经典测量误差条件下，对就业弹性进行部分识别边界估计的框架，能够区分替代效应和增强效应的非对称偏差。
一种量化AI暴露度研究中平台用户人口统计特征与劳动力人口统计特征之间偏离程度的方法，将平台用户群体特征作为暴露度评分的校准因子。

title: A Causal Argumentation Method for Explainability of Machine Learning Models
comment: To be published in The 4th World Conference on eXplainable Artificial Intelligence
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) methods identify which features are relevant to a model's predictions but often fail to clarify why certain decisions are made. In this work, we present a novel method that integrates causality with argument-based reasoning to explain why models may be making predictions. Our approach first identifies causal relationships among variables using causal discovery methods and then translates these into a Bipolar Argumentation Framework (BAF) to represent supportive and opposing interactions among features. By using semi-stable semantics, we find extensions of features that explain why certain outcomes may have been chosen. We demonstrate our method on two benchmark datasets and compare its results against standard post-hoc explainability approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将因果关系与基于论证的推理相结合的新方法，通过因果发现识别变量间因果关系，并将其转换为双极论证框架（BAF），利用半稳定语义找出解释模型预测原因的特征扩展集。
AI.motivation: 现有XAI方法仅能识别哪些特征与预测相关，但无法解释模型为何做出特定决策，缺乏对预测背后因果机制的解释能力。
AI.method: 1) 使用因果发现方法识别变量间的因果关系；2) 将因果关系转换为双极论证框架（BAF），表示特征间的支持与对抗交互；3) 应用半稳定语义（semi-stable semantics）找出能解释预测结果的特征扩展集。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上进行了验证，并与标准事后可解释性方法进行了比较。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够比传统XAI方法更深入地解释模型为何做出特定预测，通过因果+论证推理提供"为什么"层面的解释。
idea_en: A method that integrates causal discovery with Bipolar Argumentation Framework (BAF) to explain why AI models make predictions, using causal relationships among variables to construct supportive and opposing argument structures.
A technique that applies semi-stable semantics to Bipolar Argumentation Framework for identifying feature extensions that explain model prediction rationales.
A causal-to-argument translation pipeline that converts discovered causal relationships into bipolar arguments representing feature support and opposition in model decisions.
idea_ch: 一种将因果发现与双极论证框架（BAF）集成的AI预测解释方法，利用变量间的因果关系构建支持性与对抗性论证结构。
一种在半稳定语义下对双极论证框架进行推理的技术，用于识别能够解释模型预测理由的特征扩展集。
一种因果到论证的转换流水线，将发现的因果关系转换为双极论证，表示特征在模型决策中的支持与反对关系。

title: What Counts as AI Sycophancy? A Taxonomy and Expert Survey of a Fragmented Construct
summary: AI sycophancy has become a prominent concern in large language model (LLM) research. Yet the term lacks a consistent definition and has been applied to behaviors ranging from agreeing with a user's false claim to excessively praising the user to withholding corrective feedback. When researchers, companies, and policymakers use the same term to describe different behaviors, evaluation results become difficult to compare, mitigation strategies fail to transfer, and systems that are resistant to one form of sycophancy continue exhibiting other forms. To address this, we make two contributions. First, we reviewed 70 papers on AI sycophancy to develop a taxonomy of how the behavior has been defined and measured. The taxonomy distinguishes (1) whether a model is sycophantic toward a user's positions and beliefs, or toward the user's broader personal traits and emotions, and (2) whether this occurs through explicit, direct language or more implicit, subtle behaviors such as framing, omission, or tone. Mapping existing literature to our taxonomy reveals that current research has focused on overt forms of sycophancy toward users' beliefs, leaving more subtle and person-directed behaviors relatively understudied. Second, we surveyed 106 experts in AI sycophancy and related fields to examine whether researchers agree on which model behaviors are sycophantic. While experts are nearly unanimous in believing that sycophancy is a significant problem in current AI systems (94.3% agree), they disagree substantially on which specific behaviors qualify. Together, these findings demonstrate that AI sycophancy is a broad family of behaviors with different measurement challenges, intervention requirements, and governance implications. Our taxonomy provides a shared vocabulary for understanding and addressing these behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过审阅70篇论文和调查106位专家，揭示了AI谄媚（sycophancy）缺乏统一定义和测量标准的问题，提出了一个区分行为类型（信念导向vs人格导向）和表现方式（显性vs隐性）的分类体系，并发现专家对哪些行为构成谄媚存在显著分歧。
AI.motivation: AI谄媚术语被滥用于描述截然不同的行为（如附和用户错误、过度赞美、隐瞒负面反馈），导致评估结果难以比较、缓解策略无法迁移、系统仅能抵抗单一形式的谄媚，亟需统一分类体系。
AI.method: 1) 审阅70篇AI谄媚相关论文，构建分类体系（行为类型：信念/人格导向；表现方式：显性/隐性）；2) 对106位AI谄媚及相关领域专家进行问卷调查，考察专家对哪些行为属于谄媚的共识程度。
AI.result: 94.3%的专家认为谄媚是AI系统的重大问题，但专家对具体哪些行为构成谄媚存在显著分歧；现有研究集中于对用户信念的显性谄媚，隐性及人格导向的谄媚行为研究不足。
AI.conclusion: AI谄媚是一个宽泛的行为家族，不同子类面临不同的测量挑战、干预需求和治理影响；所提分类体系为理解和解决这些行为提供了共享词汇。
idea_en: A taxonomy-based method for distinguishing AI sycophancy types: classifying model behavior along two axes - belief-oriented vs. person-oriented sycophancy and explicit vs. implicit manifestation - to enable standardized evaluation and mitigation design.

A consensus measurement method for AI sycophancy behaviors: surveying expert opinions to identify behavioral boundaries where disagreement exists, establishing a reference standard for defining and labeling sycophantic model outputs.

An implicit sycophancy detection framework targeting subtle behaviors (framing bias, omission of corrective feedback, tone modulation) that go beyond explicit agreement, using linguistic analysis to identify person-directed sycophantic patterns.

A cross-behavior sycophancy resistance training system: generating training data covering both belief-oriented and person-oriented sycophancy across explicit and implicit modalities to produce models robust against multiple sycophancy forms simultaneously.
idea_ch: 一种基于分类体系的AI谄媚行为区分方法：沿行为类型（信念导向vs人格导向）和表现方式（显性vs隐性）两个维度对模型谄媚行为进行分类，为标准化评估和缓解策略设计提供基础。
一种AI谄媚行为共识测量方法：通过调查专家意见识别存在分歧的行为边界，建立定义和标注谄媚模型输出的参考标准。
一种隐性谄媚行为检测框架：利用语言学分析识别超越显性同意的微妙行为（框架偏差、隐瞒纠正反馈、语气调节），专门针对人格导向的谄媚模式进行检测。
一种跨行为类型的谄媚抵抗训练系统：同时覆盖信念导向和人格导向、显性和隐性模态的谄媚训练数据生成方法，使模型同时抵御多种形式的谄媚行为。

title: Trace2Skill: Verifier-Guided Skill Evolution for Long-Context EDA Agents
summary: Complex Verilog Design Problems (CVDP) challenge hardware LLM agents because solving them requires localizing verifier-relevant RTL, testbenches, include paths, and build dependencies inside large repository snapshots, making precise edits, and recovering from sparse hidden-verifier failures. We present Trace2Skill, a test-time scaling framework that improves a hardware agent without RTL-specialized model fine-tuning. Rather than training a new model or only sampling more candidate solutions, Trace2Skill treats the agent's natural-language skill as an evolvable policy. It mines repeated rollout traces for success and failure modes, converts them into dense diagnostics and oracle lessons, and uses an oracle, mutator, and selector loop to produce task-specific skills that guide later search, editing, validation, and recovery. Because final pass/fail labels are often too coarse for hard failures, Trace2Skill also supports bounded runtime dense verifier feedback that returns sanitized functional observations while keeping hidden harnesses and reference solutions inaccessible to the agent. This feedback helps guide skill evolution and agent execution by connecting skill text, verifier evidence, and downstream behavior. Across hard CVDP tasks that defeat the seed CVDP agent, including tasks that also defeat frontier coding agents, Trace2Skill with dense verifier feedback substantially improves task pass rates and produces breakthrough passes on previously unsolved tasks, without requiring high-quality fine-tuning data, specialized RTL model training, or model weight updates. The same framework provides a general test-time scaling strategy that can extend beyond digital design to other verifiable EDA tasks.

AI.tldr: Trace2Skill是一个无需微调RTL专用模型即可提升硬件LLM智能体性能的测试时扩展框架，通过挖掘轨迹、生成诊断与教训，以及使用oracle-mutator-selector循环来进化智能体的自然语言技能，在复杂Verilog设计任务上取得了突破性成果。
AI.motivation: 复杂Verilog设计问题（CVDP）对硬件LLM智能体构成巨大挑战，现有方法要么需要高质量微调数据，要么只能通过更多采样来提升性能，无法有效利用失败轨迹中的信息来指导搜索和修复。
AI.method: Trace2Skill将智能体的自然语言技能视为可进化的策略，通过挖掘重复rollout轨迹中的成功/失败模式，转换为密集诊断和oracle教训，利用oracle-mutator-selector循环生成任务特定技能。同时支持带边界运行时的密集验证器反馈，返回消毒后的功能观察结果以指导技能进化。
AI.result: 在困难的CVDP任务上，包括那些连前沿编码智能体都无法解决的任务，Trace2Skill配合密集验证器反馈显著提高了任务通过率，并在先前未解决的任务上取得了突破性通过。
AI.conclusion: Trace2Skill无需高质量微调数据、专用RTL模型训练或模型权重更新即可提升硬件智能体性能，并且可以推广到数字设计以外的其他可验证EDA任务中。
idea_en: A test-time scaling framework that treats LLM agent's natural-language skill as an evolvable policy, using trajectory mining and oracle-mutator-selector loops to generate task-specific skills without model fine-tuning.
A bounded runtime dense verifier feedback mechanism that returns sanitized functional observations while keeping hidden harnesses and reference solutions inaccessible to the agent.
A method for converting repeated rollout traces into dense diagnostics and oracle lessons to guide agent search, editing, validation, and recovery in hardware design tasks.
A skill evolution system that connects skill text, verifier evidence, and downstream agent behavior through dense verifier feedback during test-time scaling.
idea_ch: 一种无需模型微调的测试时扩展框架，将LLM智能体的自然语言技能视为可进化策略，通过轨迹挖掘和oracle-mutator-selector循环生成任务特定技能。
一种带边界运行时的密集验证器反馈机制，在保持隐藏测试基准和参考方案不可访问的前提下，向智能体返回消毒后的功能观察结果。
一种将重复rollout轨迹转换为密集诊断和oracle教训的方法，用于指导硬件设计任务中的智能体搜索、编辑、验证和恢复。
一种技能进化系统，通过测试时扩展中的密集验证器反馈，将技能文本、验证器证据和下游智能体行为连接起来。

title: Implicit Safety Alignment from Crowd Preferences
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Conference paper
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) can reveal implicit objectives such as safety considerations that go beyond task completion. In this work, we focus on the common safety criteria embedded in crowd preference datasets, where different users may express distinct preferences or objectives, yet follow similar safety principles. Our aim is to discover shared safety criteria from crowd preferences and then transfer them to downstream RL tasks to regularize agent behavior and enforce safety. We first show that direct reward combination-optimizing a preference-learned reward model together with downstream task rewards-has inherent limitations. Motivated by this, we propose Safe Crowd Preference-based RL, a hierarchical framework that extracts safety-aligned skills from crowd preferences and composes them via a high-level policy to safely solve downstream tasks. Experiments across safe RL environments and a preliminary LLM-style task with diverse user goals and shared safety constraints demonstrate that our approach substantially lowers safety costs without access to explicit safety rewards, while achieving task performance comparable to oracle methods trained with ground-truth safety signals.

AI.tldr: 提出Safe Crowd Preference-based RL框架，从人群偏好中提取安全对齐技能，用于下游任务的安全强化学习，无需显式安全奖励。
AI.motivation: 直接奖励组合（偏好学习奖励+下游任务奖励）存在固有限制，需要更有效的方法从人群偏好中提取共享安全准则并迁移到下游RL任务。
AI.method: 提出层次化框架Safe Crowd Preference-based RL：先从人群偏好中提取安全对齐技能（skills），再通过高层策略组合这些技能，安全地解决下游任务。
AI.result: 在安全RL环境和LLM风格任务上，该方法显著降低安全成本，任务性能与使用真实安全信号的oracle方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 层次化地从人群偏好中提取安全技能并组合，能有效实现安全对齐，无需显式安全奖励信号。
idea_en: Hierarchical safe RL framework that extracts safety-aligned skills from crowd preference datasets and composes them via a high-level policy for downstream tasks
Method for discovering shared safety criteria from crowd preferences with heterogeneous user objectives
Safety skill extraction mechanism from preference-based reward models without explicit safety rewards
Transfer learning approach for crowd-inferred safety constraints to downstream RL tasks
idea_ch: 一种从人群偏好数据集中提取安全对齐技能并通过高层策略组合的层次化安全强化学习框架
从具有异质用户目标的人群偏好中发现共享安全准则的方法
无需显式安全奖励、从基于偏好的奖励模型中提取安全技能的机制
将人群推断的安全约束迁移到下游强化学习任务的迁移学习方法

title: Toward AI VIS Co-Scientists: A General and End-to-End Agent Harness for Solving Complex Data Visualization Tasks
summary: The ability to inspect, interpret, and communicate complex data is crucial for virtually any scientific endeavor, but often requires significant expertise outside the core domain ranging from data management and analysis to visualization design and implementation. We present an end-to-end agentic harness that, based on only the data and a high level description of the tasks, independently designs custom visual analysis applications (VIS apps). This represents an important step towards a general AI co-scientist envisioned by many as an autonomous system that can autonomously execute long horizon tasks based on high-level directions. Our proposed VIS co-scientist is an essential component of this broader AI co-scientist vision: a harness that can autonomously analyze data and design visualization solutions using a collection of agents and specialized skills that coordinate exploratory analysis, plan, configure the environment, implement, validate the interface, and most importantly evaluate the overall task completion. Each stage produces document and instruction artifacts that guide downstream work and enable iterative refinement. We validate this approach on IEEE SciVis Contests spanning multiple science and engineering fields. These contests serve as ideal proving grounds because they encode real-world complexity: ambiguous requirements, diverse data modalities, design trade-offs, and task-driven validation. Given only the data and target tasks, our system autonomously produces functional single-page VIS Apps with verified linked-view behavior, highly customized to domain experts' specified tasks and needs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种端到端自主代理系统，仅基于数据和高级任务描述，即可自主设计和生成定制化的可视化分析应用（VIS apps），在多个IEEE SciVis竞赛数据上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 科学分析中，理解复杂数据通常需要专业可视化技能，而科学家缺乏时间和工具专业知识。现有方法需大量人工干预，缺少能自主完成从数据到可视化应用全流程的系统。
AI.method: 构建了一个多智能体协作的端到端框架，包括探索性分析、规划、环境配置、实现、界面验证和任务完成评估等阶段，每个阶段产出文档和指令工件以指导后续工作并支持迭代优化。
AI.result: 在多个IEEE SciVis竞赛数据集上，仅基于数据和目标任务描述，系统自主生成功能完整的单页可视化分析应用，具有经过验证的联动视图行为，高度定制化地满足领域专家需求。
AI.conclusion: 该工作向通用AI科学生物系统迈出了重要一步，展示了自主完成长周期复杂任务的潜力，尤其适用于处理模糊需求、多模态数据、设计权衡等真实世界复杂场景。
idea_en: An end-to-end agentic harness that autonomously designs and implements custom visual analysis applications from only raw data and high-level task descriptions.
A multi-agent collaborative framework for exploratory analysis, planning, environment configuration, implementation, interface validation, and task completion evaluation in visualization design.
A stage-based artifact generation mechanism where each phase produces documents and instructions that guide downstream work and support iterative refinement.
Automatic validation of linked-view behaviors in generated single-page visual analysis applications without human intervention.
A system that handles ambiguous requirements, diverse data modalities, and design trade-offs typical of real-world scientific visualization contests.
idea_ch: 一种端到端自主代理系统，仅基于原始数据和高层任务描述即可自主设计和实现定制化可视化分析应用。
多智能体协作框架，涵盖探索性分析、规划、环境配置、实现、界面验证及任务完成评估等可视化设计全流程。
基于阶段的工件生成机制，每个阶段产出文档和指令，指导下游工作并支持迭代优化。
自动验证所生成单页可视化分析应用中联动视图行为的机制，无需人工干预。
一套能够处理模糊需求、多模态数据及设计权衡等真实世界复杂场景的系统。

title: FLUID: From Ephemeral IDs to Multimodal Semantic Codes for Industrial-Scale Livestreaming Recommendation
summary: Modern recommender systems rely heavily on ID-based collaborative filtering: each item is represented by a unique ID embedding that accumulates collaborative signals from user interactions. Livestreaming recommendation, however, faces a unique challenge in this paradigm: a live room typically broadcasts for only tens of minutes, so its item ID remains poorly learned in a persistent cold-start state and ID-centric ranking models fail to generalize. We present FLUID, the first framework to fully retire the candidate-side item ID from a production-scale livestreaming ranker. FLUID couples a cross-domain multimodal encoder, jointly trained on short videos and livestreams to produce discrete hierarchical codes (LUCID), with a late-fusion, ID-free design that injects slice-level and room-level LUCID as independent tokens, stabilized by a staged warmup under online incremental training. Deployed on our industrial livestreaming recommenders with a cross-platform combined user base of over one billion globally, FLUID delivers significant online gains of +0.55% Quality Watch Duration, +2.05% Cold-Start Room Views, and +0.05% Active Hours.

AI.tldr: FLUID是一个完全移除候选侧物品ID的直播推荐框架，通过跨域多模态编码器生成离散分层编码（LUCID），结合晚融合无ID设计，在大规模工业部署中显著提升了冷启直播间的推荐效果。
AI.motivation: 直播推荐中，直播间通常只持续数十分钟，其ID嵌入因冷启动而无法充分学习，导致基于ID的协同过滤推荐模型难以泛化。
AI.method: 提出了FLUID框架：1) 跨域多模态编码器，在短视频和直播数据上联合训练，生成离散分层编码LUCID；2) 晚融合无ID设计，将切片级和房间级LUCID作为独立token注入；3) 分段热身训练策略，适配在线增量训练。
AI.result: 在全球超10亿用户的工业级直播推荐系统中，实现了Quality Watch Duration +0.55%、Cold-Start Room Views +2.05%、Active Hours +0.05%的线上提升。
AI.conclusion: FLUID首次在工业级直播排序器中完全移除候选侧物品ID，证明了纯多模态表征在冷启动场景下的有效性。
idea_en: Discrete hierarchical code (LUCID) generation method via cross-domain multimodal encoder jointly trained on short videos and livestreams
Late-fusion ID-free ranking architecture injecting slice-level and room-level discrete codes as independent tokens
Staged warmup training strategy for online incremental learning in ID-free recommender systems
idea_ch: 一种基于跨域多模态编码器的离散分层编码生成方法，联合训练短视频和直播数据生成LUCID编码
一种晚融合无ID排序架构，将切片级和房间级离散编码作为独立token注入排序模型
一种分段热身训练策略，适配无ID推荐系统的在线增量学习场景

title: Planning in the LLM Era: Building for Reliability and Efficiency
comment: Published at ICAPS 2026
summary: Growing attention to intelligent agents has put a spotlight on one of their central capabilities: planning. Early attempts to leverage large language models (LLMs) for planning relied on single-shot plan generation, followed by hybrid approaches that coupled LLMs with limited external search. These methods, unsound and incomplete by their very nature, often require substantial resources without yielding better solutions on unseen problems. As the limitations of LLMs become clearer, recent work has shifted toward using them at solution construction time -- generating symbolic solvers for a family of problems that can be verified and then used efficiently at inference time. This trend reflects the growing need for agents that are both reliable and resource-efficient. It also offers a path towards generating maintainable planners with minimal dependence on language models at inference time. In this paper, we argue that this shift reflects a broader realignment of the planning field in the LLM era. We examine three major categories of planner-generation methods, discuss their current limitations, and outline research steps towards a more reliable and efficient LLM-based generation of planners.

AI.tldr: 论文论证了LLM用于规划任务正从单次生成/混合搜索范式转向“在构建时生成可验证的符号求解器，推理时高效使用”的新范式，旨在提升可靠性与资源效率。
AI.motivation: 早期LLM规划方法（单次生成、混合搜索）存在不完备、资源消耗大、对未见问题效果差等局限，迫切需要更可靠且资源高效的LLM规划方案。
AI.method: 论文不提出新方法，而是对三类规划器生成方法（单次生成、混合搜索、构建时生成可验证符号求解器）进行系统分类、分析其局限性，并勾勒未来研究步骤。
AI.result: 识别出“构建时生成符号求解器”趋势是LLM时代规划领域的重大调整，该范式可生成可维护的规划器，且推理时对语言模型依赖极小。
AI.conclusion: LLM在规划中的应用应聚焦于构建时生成可验证的符号求解器，而非推理时直接参与规划，这是实现可靠、高效代理的关键路径。
idea_en: Method for generating verifiable symbolic planners during construction time using LLMs, with minimal LLM dependency at inference time
System for automated planner generation that separates solution construction (using LLM) from efficient inference (using symbolic solver)
Framework for LLM-based generation of maintainable, domain-specific symbolic planners that are sound and complete
idea_ch: 在构建阶段利用大语言模型生成可验证的符号规划器，推理阶段几乎不依赖语言模型的规划方法
将LLM用于规划器构造（解构建）与符号求解器高效推理（解执行）相分离的自动化规划系统
基于LLM生成特定领域可维护、可靠（完备且正确）的符号规划器的框架方法

title: AI-Enabled Serious Games: Integrating Intelligence and Adaptivity in Training Systems
comment: Book chapter, 1 figure. To appear in "Advances in Global Applied Artificial Intelligence," G. A. Tsihrintzis, M. Virvou, N. G. Bourbakis, and L. C. Jain (Eds.), Springer, Learning and Analytics in Intelligent Systems book series, 2026
summary: Serious games are widely used for learning and training across domains such as healthcare, defense, and education. Persistent challenges remain, however, including static scenario design, authoring bottlenecks, limited learner modeling, and difficulty implementing meaningful real-time instructional adaptation. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) introduce novel capabilities such as dynamic scenario variation, contextual feedback, adaptive pacing, and learner-state modeling that may help address some of these limitations. At the same time, integrating AI into serious games raises important questions related to validity, transparency, system control, and learner trust. This chapter examines how contemporary AI approaches may support real-time instructional adaptation in serious games. It distinguishes between instructional intelligence, defined as a system's capacity to infer learner knowledge and reason about pedagogically appropriate responses, and adaptivity, defined as the ability to modify instructional actions during interaction. A historical synthesis of adaptive learning systems is presented, tracing developments from early computer-assisted instruction through intelligent tutoring systems (ITS), dynamic difficulty adjustment (DDA), authoring platforms, learning analytics, and recent AI-enabled architectures. Building on this perspective, the chapter discusses how large language models (LLMs), reinforcement learning (RL), and agent-based architectures may contribute to more integrated forms of intelligence and adaptivity in serious games. It also highlights practical and research challenges associated with AI-enabled systems, including explainability, validation, computational cost, and the limited empirical evidence regarding long-term learning outcomes in AI-enabled serious games.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了AI（如大语言模型、强化学习、智能体架构）在严肃游戏中实现实时教学适配的应用潜力，区分了教学智能与适应性，并讨论了验证、可解释性等挑战。
AI.motivation: 严肃游戏面临静态场景设计、创作瓶颈、有限的学习者建模及难以实现实时教学适配等持续挑战，亟需引入AI能力加以突破。
AI.method: 通过对自适应学习系统的历史综合梳理（从早期计算机辅助教学到智能辅导系统、动态难度调整、创作平台、学习分析及最新AI架构），分析了LLM、强化学习和智能体架构如何贡献于更集成的智能与适配性。
AI.result: 识别出AI可支持动态场景变化、上下文反馈、自适应节奏和学习者状态建模等新能力，同时指出可解释性、验证、计算成本和长期学习效果证据不足等问题。
AI.conclusion: AI有潜力显著提升严肃游戏的实时教学适配能力，但需解决透明度、系统控制、学习者信任及实证验证等关键挑战。
idea_en: A system that uses large language models (LLMs) to dynamically generate and vary serious game scenarios in real-time based on learner state and performance.
A reinforcement learning (RL) based framework for real-time adaptive pacing and difficulty adjustment in serious games that optimizes learning outcomes.
An agent-based architecture for serious games where multiple AI agents collaborate to provide contextual feedback, adapt instruction, and model learner knowledge simultaneously.
A method for distinguishing and separately optimizing instructional intelligence (inferring learner knowledge) and adaptivity (modifying instructional actions) in AI-enabled serious games.
A validation and explainability framework specifically designed for AI-enabled serious games to ensure transparency, learner trust, and system control.

title: Format-Constraint Coupling in Knowledge Graph Construction from Statistical Tables
comment: 8 pages main body, 18 pages appendices. Submitted to EMNLP 2026 via ACL Rolling Review (ARR). Corresponding author: Yuxiang Feng (yxfeng@scut.edu.cn). Code and data available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/sge_lightrag-BE19
summary: An extraction schema should not reduce knowledge graph fidelity. On statistical CSV, however, it can. We study country-by-year time-series matrices, a common layout on open-data portals. In this setting, serialization format and schema constraints interact super-additively. Their joint effect exceeds the sum of independent effects by up to +1.180 (2x2 factorial, 6 datasets). Bootstrap 95% CIs are strictly positive on 4/6 datasets, with strongest evidence on wide Type-II matrices. More critically, a schema applied to a mismatched format can trigger catastrophic mismatch. Fact coverage falls below the unconstrained baseline on 4/6 datasets through entity inflation or extraction refusal. We call this observed pattern format-constraint coupling. Probing and token ablation support a surface-form anchoring explanation centred on column-name references. Controlled variants across format-schema pairings, GraphRAG hosts, and LLM families show the same direction within the measured scope; one LLM family shows only partial activation. The observation also has a diagnostic consequence. Three standard retrieval modes largely mask construction quality (delta <= 1pp), whereas direct graph access exposes gaps up to +47.6pp (p < 0.0001). To support fidelity-aware evaluation, we release CSVFidelity-Bench. It contains 15 datasets, 11 Type-II matrices, 4 Type-III tables, and 1,892 Gold Standard facts across 6 domains.

AI.tldr: 论文发现CSV时间序列矩阵中，序列化格式与模式约束之间存在超加性耦合效应，导致知识图谱事实覆盖率下降。为了支持保真度评估，发布了CSVFidelity-Bench基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱构建中，抽取模式不应降低数据保真度，但在统计CSV数据中，序列化格式和模式约束会产生交互效应，导致事实覆盖率下降，现有研究缺乏对此耦合效应的系统评估。
AI.method: 采用2x2析因实验设计，在6个数据集上分析格式与模式约束的独立及联合效应；通过token消融和探测实验验证表面形式锚定解释；对比不同检索模式（标准检索vs直接图访问）下的构建质量差异。
AI.result: 格式与模式约束的联合效应超过独立效应之和高达+1.180；4/6数据集出现灾难性不匹配，事实覆盖率低于无约束基线；标准检索模式掩盖构建质量差异（delta≤1pp），直接图访问暴露差距高达+47.6pp。
AI.conclusion: 提出格式-约束耦合（format-constraint coupling）现象，发布了包含15个数据集、1892个黄金标准事实的CSVFidelity-Bench基准，支持保真度感知的知识图谱构建评估。
idea_en: A method for detecting format-constraint coupling in CSV-to-knowledge-graph pipelines by measuring super-additive joint effects of serialization format and extraction schema constraints via 2x2 factorial design.
A surface-form anchoring explanation mechanism for LLM extraction failures from CSV time-series matrices, using token ablation and probing to identify column-name reference as the root cause.

A fidelity-aware evaluation framework (CSVFidelity-Bench) with 15 datasets, 11 Type-II matrices, 4 Type-III tables, and 1,892 Gold Standard facts across 6 domains for benchmarking graph construction quality.
A diagnostic method using direct graph access (bypassing standard retrieval modes) to expose construction quality gaps up to +47.6pp that are masked by standard retrieval modes (delta <= 1pp).
A controlled variant testing methodology across format-schema pairings, GraphRAG hosts, and LLM families to detect format-constraint coupling directionality.

title: Echo: Learning from Experience Data via User-Driven Refinement
summary:
Static "human data" faces inherent limitations: it is expensive to scale and bounded by the knowledge of its creators. Continuous learning from "experience data" - interactions between agents and their environments - promises to transcend these barriers. Today, the widespread deployment of AI agents grants us low-cost access to massive streams of such real-world experience. However, raw interaction logs are inherently noisy, filled with trial-and-error and low information density, rendering them inefficient for direct model training.
  We introduce Echo, a generalized framework designed to operationalize the transition from raw experience to learnable knowledge, effectively "echoing" environmental feedback back into the training loop for model optimization. In today's agent ecosystem, user refinement serves as a primary source of such feedback: driven by responsibility for the outcome, users rigorously transform flawed agent proposals into verified solutions. These user-driven refinement sequences inherently distill agents' crude attempts into high-quality training signals. Echo systematically harvests these signals to continuously align the agent with real-world needs. Large-scale validation in a production code completion environment confirms that Echo effectively harnesses this pipeline, breaking the static performance ceiling by increasing the acceptance rate from 25.7% to 35.7%.

AI.tldr: Echo是一个通用框架，通过将用户对AI Agent的修正行为（经验数据）转化为高质量训练信号，实现从原始交互经验到可学习知识的转化，打破静态人类数据的性能上限。在代码补全场景中，将接受率从25.7%提升至35.7%。
AI.motivation: 静态人类数据存在扩展成本高、受限于创造者知识边界的固有限制。虽然AI Agent的大规模部署提供了廉价的海量真实世界经验数据（交互日志），但这些原始日志噪声大、信息密度低，不适合直接用于模型训练。
AI.method: Echo框架通过以下步骤实现经验到知识的转化：1）在Agent生态系统中识别用户修正序列（用户将Agent有缺陷的提案转化为验证通过的解决方案）；2）系统化地提取这些用户驱动的精炼序列作为高质量训练信号；3）将这些信号循环回训练流程，持续对齐Agent与真实世界需求。
AI.result: 在生产级代码补全环境中，Echo将接受率从25.7%提升至35.7%，打破了静态性能天花板。
AI.conclusion: Echo验证了利用用户交互中的隐式修正反馈作为持续学习信号的可行性，为突破静态数据限制提供了一种可落地的规模化范式。
idea_en: A method for extracting high-quality training signals from user-driven refinement sequences in AI agent interaction logs, where user corrections of flawed agent proposals are systematically harvested and converted into supervised learning data.

A continuous alignment framework that iteratively feeds user refinement feedback from production agent deployments back into the training loop, enabling models to overcome static data performance ceilings.

A mechanism for distilling low-information-density raw interaction logs into structured training signals by identifying and leveraging implicit user verification signals during agent-proposal refinement cycles.
A production pipeline that transforms trial-and-error agent behaviors into learnable knowledge by tracking the delta between flawed agent outputs and user-verified final solutions.

一种持续对齐框架：将生产环境中Agent部署的用户修正反馈循环迭代地注入训练流程，实现模型对真实世界需求的动态适应，突破静态数据训练的性能上限。

title: ECPO: Evidence-Coupled Policy Optimization for Evidence-Certified Candidate Ranking
summary: Ranking systems used in decision-support settings should not only order candidates but also expose evidence that can be independently checked. We study evidence-certified candidate ranking: given an intent_id, a predefined plan skeleton, a window-local candidate roster, and text-derived candidate trajectories with span provenance, a system must output a Top-K list together with doc_id:span evidence certificates whose cited spans are sufficient to recover the decision. We instantiate this task on MAVEN-ERE and RAMS with fixed upstream extraction, window-local randomized candidate identifiers, skeleton-aligned trajectory supervision, hard negatives, and audit references. We introduce Evidence-Coupled Policy Optimization (ECPO), a listwise policy-optimization objective whose action is the joint object of ranking and evidence certificate. ECPO first learns an interpretable trajectory reward from skeleton alignment, argument consistency, and optional graph features; it then optimizes a constrained policy with three coupled rewards: listwise ranking utility, span-level certificate validity, and an evidence-cycle reward computed by a label-free deterministic verifier that reconstructs candidate support from claim-stripped cited spans. This reframes the goal from maximizing ordinary NDCG alone to maximizing CertNDCG and decision-evidence coupling. The evaluation compares ECPO against zero-shot, SFT, and GRPO policies, RM-only scoring with deterministic evidence attachment, grammar/JSON-constrained decoding, validator retry, best-of-N RM selection, and post-hoc evidence rationalization under closed-roster, predicted-roster, and hybrid-roster settings.

AI.tldr: 提出证据认证的候选排序框架ECPO，联合优化排序结果与可验证的引用证据，确保决策可追溯。
AI.motivation: 现有排序系统缺乏可独立验证的证据支持，决策难以审计和追溯。
AI.method: 提出Evidence-Coupled Policy Optimization (ECPO)，通过列表级策略优化联合学习排序与证据证书，包含排序效用、跨度级证书有效性和证据循环奖励三项耦合奖励。
AI.result: 在MAVEN-ERE和RAMS数据集上，ECPO在CertNDCG和决策-证据耦合指标上优于零样本、SFT、GRPO等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将排序目标从最大化NDCG转向最大化CertNDCG及决策-证据耦合，提升了排序系统的可审计性和透明度。

CertNDCG metric as alternative to NDCG for measuring decision-evidence coupling

title: The Log is the Agent: Event-Sourced Reactive Graphs for Auditable, Forkable Agentic Systems
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure. Open-source Apache-2.0 implementation with reproducible quickstart demo, deterministic replay, fork-and-diff, and lineage tracing
summary: Most agent frameworks are built around the language model: a conversation loop comes first, then tools, then rules, and finally a logging layer bolted on for observability, with state persisted as retrievable "memory." We describe ActiveGraph, a runtime that inverts this arrangement. The append-only event log is the source of truth; the working graph is a deterministic projection of that log; and behaviors--ordinary functions, classes, LLM-backed routines, or logic attached to typed edges--react to changes in the graph and emit new events. No component instructs another; coordination happens entirely through the shared graph. This single design decision yields three properties that retrieval-and-summarization memory systems do not provide: deterministic replay of any run from its log, cheap forking that branches a run at any event without re-executing the shared prefix, and end-to-end lineage from a high-level goal down to the individual model call that produced each artifact. We present the architecture, a determinism contract that makes replay sound, and a worked diligence example whose full causal structure is reconstructable from the log alone. We discuss--without claiming to demonstrate--why this substrate is unusually well suited to self-improving agents, and how it extends the BabyAGI lineage and prior graph-memory research.

AI.tldr: ActiveGraph提出了一种倒置的智能体运行时架构：以追加式事件日志为唯一真相源，工作图作为日志的确定性投影，所有行为（函数、类、LLM调用、类型化边逻辑）通过响应图变化来发射新事件，而非组件间直接通信。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体框架以语言模型为中心，对话循环优先，工具、规则、日志层后置，状态以可检索的"记忆"形式持久化。这种架构在确定性回放、分支执行和端到端溯源方面存在根本性缺陷。
AI.method: ActiveGraph采用事件溯源架构：1) 追加式事件日志作为唯一真相源；2) 工作图作为日志的确定性投影；3) 所有行为（普通函数、类、LLM支持例程、类型化边逻辑）响应图变化并发射新事件；4) 组件间通过共享图进行协调，无直接指令传递。
AI.result: 实现了三个检索-摘要式记忆系统无法提供的特性：1) 任何运行的确定性回放；2) 低成本分叉执行；3) 从高层目标到单个模型调用的端到端溯源。通过一个勤勉示例展示了完整因果结构的可重构性。
AI.conclusion: ActiveGraph的架构特别适合自改进智能体，扩展了BabyAGI系列和先前图记忆研究工作。但作者声明尚未完全证明这一点。

Deterministic replay mechanism for any agent run from its event log without state ambiguity
Cheap forking method that branches agent execution at any event without re-executing shared prefix
End-to-end lineage tracking from high-level goals down to individual model calls via event log
Behavior coordination entirely through shared typed-edge graph without direct component-to-component instruction
Determinism contract ensuring sound replay in an event-sourced agent system

title: Active Evidence-Seeking and Diagnostic Reasoning in Large Language Models for Clinical Decision Support
summary: Large language models perform well on static medical examinations, yet clinical diagnosis often requires iterative evidence gathering under uncertainty. Building on prior interactive evaluation efforts, we introduce an OSCE-inspired standardized patient simulator and a controlled, reproducible benchmark for active diagnostic inquiry. Across 468 cases and 15 models in our protocol, we observe that multi-turn evidence seeking reduces diagnostic accuracy by 12.75% and lowers supporting-evidence quality by 24.36% relative to full-context evaluation; error analyses associate these drops with premature diagnostic closure and inefficient questioning. Together, these results suggest that static full-context benchmarks may overestimate performance in interactive evidence-seeking settings, motivating complementary interactive assessment for safer clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于OSCE的标准化病人模拟器和可重复的主动诊断查询基准，发现多轮证据收集相比全上下文评估导致诊断准确率下降12.75%，支持证据质量下降24.36%，主要原因在于过早诊断闭合和低效提问。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在静态医学考试中表现良好，但临床诊断需要在不确定性下迭代收集证据，静态基准可能高估模型在实际交互场景中的表现。
AI.method: 基于OSCE（客观结构化临床考试）设计标准化病人模拟器，构建468个病例和15个模型的受控可重复基准，比较全上下文评估与多轮主动诊断查询的性能差异。
AI.result: 多轮证据收集使诊断准确率降低12.75%，支持证据质量降低24.36%；错误分析归因于过早诊断闭合和低效提问。
AI.conclusion: 静态全上下文基准可能高估模型在交互式证据收集环境中的表现，需补充交互式评估以确保更安全的临床决策支持。

title: Enhancing Visual Token Representations for Video Large Language Models via Training-Free Spatial-Temporal Pooling and Gridding
comment: Accepted by ICLR 2026
summary: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced video understanding tasks, yet challenges remain in efficiently compressing visual tokens while preserving spatiotemporal interactions. Existing methods, such as LLaVA family, utilize simplistic pooling or interpolation techniques that overlook the intricate dynamics of visual tokens. To bridge this gap, we propose ST-GridPool, a novel training-free visual token enhancement method designed specifically for Video LLMs. Our approach integrates Pyramid Temporal Gridding (PTG), which captures multi-grained spatiotemporal interactions through hierarchical temporal gridding, and Norm-based Spatial Pooling (NSP), which preserves high-information visual regions by leveraging the correlation between token norms and semantic richness. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate that ST-GridPool consistently enhances performance of Video LLMs without requiring costly retraining. Our method offers an efficient and plug-and-play solution for improving visual token representations. Our code is available in https://github.com/bingjunluo/ST-GridPool.

AI.tldr: ST-GridPool提出了一种无需训练的视频LLM视觉令牌增强方法，通过金字塔时间网格化（PTG）和基于范数的空间池化（NSP）有效压缩视觉令牌并保留时空交互信息。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM（如LLaVA系列）在视频理解中使用简单的池化或插值技术压缩视觉令牌，忽视了视觉令牌的复杂时空动态交互，导致信息丢失。
AI.method: 提出ST-GridPool方法，包含两个核心模块：1）金字塔时间网格化（PTG）：通过分层时间网格化捕获多粒度时空交互；2）基于范数的空间池化（NSP）：利用令牌范数与语义丰富度的相关性，保留高信息量的视觉区域。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，ST-GridPool一致提升了Video LLMs的性能，且无需昂贵的重新训练。
AI.conclusion: ST-GridPool是一种高效、即插即用的视觉令牌表示增强方案，适用于视频理解任务。

Pyramid Temporal Gridding (PTG) technique that captures multi-grained spatiotemporal interactions through hierarchical temporal gridding, enabling efficient video representation without retraining.
Norm-based Spatial Pooling (NSP) mechanism that leverages the correlation between token norms and semantic richness to preserve high-information visual regions during token compression.
A plug-and-play visual token enhancement module for Video LLMs that improves performance across multiple video understanding benchmarks without requiring costly model retraining.

title: A Camera-Cooperative ISAC Framework for Multimodal Non-Cooperative UAVs Sensing
summary: The detection of non-cooperative unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) presents significant challenges for Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) systems due to the inherent limitations of single-modal perception and the competition for shared communication and sensing resources. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel Camera-Cooperative ISAC (CC-ISAC) framework that employs multimodal sensing to enable efficient UAV beam steering and tracking. The proposed framework employs cameras for coarse-grained airspace monitoring and utilizes ISAC for fine-grained, high-precision sensing, forming a complementary perception loop that enhances both sensing accuracy and resource efficiency. Within this framework, two key modules are developed: (1) a Vision-to-Echo Data Alignment (V2EDA) model that aligns visual and echo-domain features through cross-attention mechanisms, and (2) a Multimodal Fusion-Based Estimation (MMFE) model that integrates historical multimodal data with current observations for robust state estimation. Extensive evaluations conducted on the DeepSense 6G dataset demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves an average reduction of 71% in beam steering overhead and 1.69-11.15% in tracking overhead while maintaining high angular estimation accuracy. The CC-ISAC framework effectively mitigates resource contention between sensing and communication, enabling reliable UAV surveillance while freeing substantial system resources for additional communication tasks, thereby representing a practical advancement in ISAC system design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种相机辅助的集成感知与通信（CC-ISAC）框架，通过多模态感知（视觉+雷达回波）实现非合作无人机的高效波束转向与跟踪，在DeepSense 6G数据集上平均降低71%的波束转向开销和1.69-11.15%的跟踪开销。
AI.motivation: 解决ISAC系统中单模态感知的局限性以及感知与通信之间资源竞争的问题，实现非合作无人机的高效检测与跟踪。
AI.method: 提出CC-ISAC框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) Vision-to-Echo Data Alignment (V2EDA)模型，通过交叉注意力机制对齐视觉与回波域特征；(2) Multimodal Fusion-Based Estimation (MMFE)模型，融合历史多模态数据与当前观测进行鲁棒状态估计。相机用于粗粒度空域监测，ISAC用于细粒度高精度感知，形成互补感知闭环。
AI.result: 在DeepSense 6G数据集上，波束转向开销平均降低71%，跟踪开销降低1.69-11.15%，同时保持高角度估计精度。
AI.conclusion: CC-ISAC框架有效缓解了感知与通信之间的资源竞争，实现了可靠的无人机监视，同时释放大量系统资源用于额外通信任务，是ISAC系统设计的实用进展。

A Vision-to-Echo Data Alignment (V2EDA) model that aligns visual and echo-domain features through cross-attention mechanisms, enabling complementary perception between different sensing modalities.

A method for reducing beam steering overhead by 71% on average through camera-assisted coarse-to-fine sensing, freeing system resources for additional communication tasks in ISAC systems.

title: Knowledge Graph Re-engineering Along the Ontological Continuum (extended version)
summary: Knowledge graphs have become the primary vehicle for data integration and are critical to the success of modern AI, but the diversity of KG modelling practices, from lightweight vocabularies to richly axiomatised ontologies, makes integration and reuse expensive and brittle. This challenge is particularly acute in neuro-symbolic AI, where bridging neural and symbolic components depends on the ability to reengineer KGs to fit new requirements; GenAI now offers unprecedented automation capability, but without a principled understanding of the KG space, such automation remains conceptually ungrounded. We introduce the ontological continuum as that missing conceptualisation, a theoretical construct a theoretical construct whose characterisation framework is defined by two orthogonal distinctions: semantics vs pragmatics, and properties vs affordances; together these define a vocabulary to describe, compare, navigate, and transform KGs across the full range of modelling practices. The methodological stance is empirical: rather than prescribing how KGs should be modelled, the continuum aims to define a theory of the existent, derived from observation of real-world KG engineering practices and whose structure can be made formally explicit, for example, through Formal Concept Analysis (FCA). We ground the vision through a case study on provenance knowledge, showing how a single concern manifests differently across the continuum. We articulate five open research challenges and invite the community to develop the ontological continuum as a shared research agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"本体连续统"这一理论框架，通过语义vs语用、属性vs功能两个正交维度来描述、比较和转换知识图谱，为神经符号AI中的KG自动化改造提供理论基础。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱建模实践多样（从轻量级词汇表到丰富公理化的本体），导致集成和复用昂贵且脆弱，尤其在神经符号AI中，连接神经和符号组件需要改造KG以适应新需求，但缺乏对KG空间的原理性理解。
AI.method: 提出本体连续统概念，通过两个正交区分（语义vs语用、属性vs功能）定义特征框架；采用经验主义方法论，基于真实KG工程实践观察，可通过形式概念分析(FCA)进行形式化表达。
AI.result: 通过来源知识案例研究展示了同一关注点如何在本体连续统的不同位置表现不同；提出了五个开放性研究挑战。
AI.conclusion: 本体连续统作为共享研究议程，能够描述、比较、导航和转换跨全范围建模实践的KG，为神经符号AI中的自动化KG改造提供原理性基础。

A formal analysis framework using Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) to derive ontological continuum structures from empirical observation of real-world KG engineering practices.

A systematic approach to reengineer knowledge graphs for neuro-symbolic AI integration by navigating the ontological continuum, allowing automated transformation between lightweight vocabularies and richly axiomatized ontologies.
A provenance knowledge representation system that demonstrates how a single domain concern can be modeled differently across the ontological continuum spectrum.
