title: MPDocBench-Parse: Benchmarking Practical Multi-page Document Parsing
summary: Document parsing converts visually rich documents into machine-readable structured representations, forming a crucial foundation for information systems. Although many benchmarks have been proposed for document parsing, they remain inadequate for realistic scenarios. Existing benchmarks either focus on specific tasks or assess only single-page, text-centric settings, making them insufficient for practical multi-page parsing. Moreover, they lack fine-grained evaluation of semantic continuity, hierarchical structure recovery, and visual content preservation. To address these gaps, we propose MPDocBench-Parse, a benchmark for multi-page document parsing in real-world applications. It contains 433 manually annotated documents with 3,246 pages, covering 15 document types in English and Chinese, with diverse layout styles, and supports document-level end-to-end evaluation. We further design a comprehensive protocol for content fidelity and logical structure, covering text, table, and formula recognition, truncated text and table merging, figure extraction, reading order, and heading hierarchy recovery. Experiments show that, while existing models perform well on basic text extraction, they still suffer clear limitations in semantic continuity integration, visual content parsing, and hierarchical structure recovery. MPDocBench-Parse provides a unified foundation for advancing document parsing toward more realistic scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出MPDocBench-Parse基准，一个面向多页文档解析的真实场景评测数据集，包含433份手动标注文档（3246页），覆盖15种文档类型，支持文档级别端到端评估。
AI.motivation: 现有文档解析基准存在三点不足：1）仅关注特定任务或单页文本场景；2）缺乏对多页文档的评估；3）缺乏对语义连续性、层次结构恢复和视觉内容保留的细粒度评估。
AI.method: 构建包含433份多页文档（3246页）的标注数据集，覆盖中英文15种文档类型；设计全面的评估协议，涵盖文本/表格/公式识别、截断文本与表格合并、图形提取、阅读顺序和标题层次恢复。
AI.result: 现有模型在基础文本提取表现良好，但在语义连续性整合、视觉内容解析和层次结构恢复方面存在明显局限。
AI.conclusion: MPDocBench-Parse为推进文档解析向更真实场景发展提供了统一基础。
idea_en: A multi-page document parsing benchmark with manual annotations across 15 document types, supporting document-level end-to-end evaluation
A comprehensive evaluation protocol covering content fidelity and logical structure including text/table/formula recognition, truncated content merging, reading order, and heading hierarchy recovery
A fine-grained evaluation method for semantic continuity integration and hierarchical structure recovery in document parsing
idea_ch: 一种面向多页文档的端到端解析评测基准，覆盖15种文档类型（中英文），支持文档级评估而非单页评估
一种综合性的文档解析评估协议，同时评估内容保真度（文本/表格/公式识别、截断合并、图形提取）和逻辑结构（阅读顺序、标题层次恢复）
一种针对文档解析中语义连续性整合的细粒度评估方法，可检测模型在多页间保持语义连贯性的能力

title: ExComm: Exploration-Stage Communication for Error-Resilient Agentic Test-Time Scaling
summary: A common failure mode in long-horizon agentic test-time scaling is error propagation, where factual errors or invalid deductions introduced at intermediate steps persist in the agent's belief state and contaminate later reasoning. Existing test-time scaling methods provide limited control over this process, as they often rely on agents to detect their own mistakes, select among flawed trajectories, or refine solutions only after errors have already shaped the reasoning path. We propose ExComm, a communication protocol for exploration-stage agentic test-time scaling. ExComm is motivated by the empirical observation that the majority of intermediate errors in parallel agentic reasoning produce detectable cross-agent factual conflicts. Leveraging the iterative structure of agentic workflows, ExComm periodically audits agent belief states to detect such conflicts, resolves them through a dedicated tool-based verification loop, and returns concise, targeted feedback to the involved agents. Corrections are incorporated through soft belief updates, which append verified feedback rather than overwriting existing beliefs. Furthermore, to prevent collapsing trajectory diversity due to communication, ExComm further introduces a trajectory diversification module that redirects redundant trajectories toward orthogonal strategies. Experiments on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and GAIA with Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite and Qwen3.5-4B show that ExComm consistently outperforms strong test-time scaling baselines, achieving average performance gains of 5.7% and 5.0% over the best-performing baselines, respectively. Further analyses demonstrate improved error recovery, favorable scaling behavior, stronger diversity than adapted communication baselines, and the best performance-cost trade-off among the evaluated methods.

AI.tldr: 提出ExComm通信协议，通过跨智能体冲突检测、工具验证循环和软信念更新，解决长视距代理测试时缩放中的错误传播问题，在AIME和GAIA基准上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 长视距代理测试时缩放中存在错误传播问题，中间步骤的错误会持续污染后续推理，现有方法依赖智能体自我纠错或事后修正，对错误传播过程的控制有限。
AI.method: ExComm协议：周期性审计智能体信念状态以检测跨智能体事实冲突，通过专用工具验证循环解决冲突，返回针对性反馈；采用软信念更新（追加而非覆盖）；引入轨迹多样化模块防止通信导致轨迹多样性坍塌。
AI.result: 在AIME 2024、AIME 2025和GAIA上，ExComm一致优于强基线，平均性能提升5.7%（Gemini）和5.0%（Qwen），且展现出更好的错误恢复能力、扩展行为和性价比。
AI.conclusion: ExComm通过主动跨智能体冲突检测与软信念更新，有效控制错误传播，并兼顾轨迹多样性，为代理测试时缩放提供了更优的通信协议方案。
idea_en: A method for detecting cross-agent factual conflicts in parallel agentic reasoning systems by periodically auditing agent belief states during exploration-stage test-time scaling.
A tool-based verification loop that resolves detected factual conflicts and generates concise, targeted feedback for involved agents without overwriting their existing beliefs.
A soft belief update mechanism that appends verified feedback to agent beliefs rather than replacing them, preserving original reasoning traces while correcting errors.
A trajectory diversification module that redirects redundant trajectories toward orthogonal strategies to prevent diversity collapse caused by inter-agent communication.
A communication protocol (ExComm) for exploration-stage agentic test-time scaling that combines conflict detection, verification-based resolution, soft belief updates, and trajectory diversification.
idea_ch: 一种在并行代理推理系统中检测跨智能体事实冲突的方法，通过在探索阶段测试时缩放中周期性审计智能体信念状态实现。
一种基于工具的验证循环，用于解决检测到的事实冲突，并向相关智能体生成简洁、有针对性的反馈，且不覆盖其现有信念。
一种软信念更新机制，将经过验证的反馈追加到智能体信念中而非替换原有信念，在纠正错误的同时保留原始推理轨迹。
一种轨迹多样化模块，将冗余轨迹重定向至正交策略，防止智能体间通信导致的轨迹多样性坍塌。
一种用于探索阶段代理测试时缩放的通信协议（ExComm），融合了冲突检测、基于验证的解析、软信念更新和轨迹多样化技术。

title: ArborKV: Structure-Aware KV Cache Management for Scaling Tree-based LLM Reasoning
summary: Recent progress in LLM reasoning has increasingly shifted from single-pass generation to explicit search over intermediate reasoning states. Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) organizes inference to tree-structured search with branching and backtracking, but it substantially amplifies the Key--Value (KV) cache: retaining KV states for a frontier of partial trajectories quickly becomes a memory bottleneck that limits throughput and constrains search depth and width under fixed hardware budgets. We address this challenge by observing that KV reuse in ToT-style inference is governed by search dynamics: near-term decoding depends primarily on the active branch and its ancestors, whereas inactive subtrees have low short-term reuse probability yet must remain recoverable for backtracking. Motivated by this, we propose ArborKV, a structure-aware eviction framework that couples a lightweight value estimator with a tree-aware allocation policy, and performs purely token-extractive eviction with lazy rehydration to support revisits. Experiments on ToT-style reasoning benchmarks show that ArborKV achieves up to ~4x peak KV-memory reduction while preserving near-full-retention accuracy, enabling larger search configurations under fixed device budgets that would otherwise run out of memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ArborKV，一种结构感知的KV缓存淘汰框架，用于树形推理（如Tree-of-Thoughts）中，通过轻量值估计和树感知分配策略，结合惰性重补水机制，在不显著影响准确率的情况下将峰值KV内存降低约4倍，从而支持更大规模的搜索配置。
AI.motivation: Tree-of-Thoughts（ToT）等树形推理方法在中间推理状态上显式搜索，但会大幅放大KV缓存——保留多个分支路径的KV状态成为内存瓶颈，限制了固定硬件预算下的搜索深度和宽度。
AI.method: ArborKV包含三个核心组件：1) 轻量值估计器，预测每个子树未来被重新访问的概率；2) 树感知分配策略，根据搜索树结构决定哪些KV状态应保留；3) 纯令牌提取式淘汰与惰性重补水机制，仅淘汰具体token且支持在回溯时按需恢复。
AI.result: 在ToT风格推理基准测试中，ArborKV实现了高达约4倍的峰值KV内存减少，同时保持了接近完整保留的准确率，使在固定设备预算下能够运行更大规模的搜索配置。
AI.conclusion: ArborKV证明，通过利用树形搜索的动态特性进行结构感知的KV缓存管理，可以大幅缓解推理过程中的内存瓶颈，为大规模树形推理提供了实用解决方案。
idea_en: A structure-aware KV cache eviction framework for tree-structured LLM reasoning, which uses a lightweight value estimator to predict subtree revisit probability and a tree-aware allocation policy to selectively retain KV states.

A lazy rehydration mechanism that performs token-extractive eviction of KV states from inactive subtrees, enabling efficient memory recovery while preserving the ability to reconstruct states on backtracking.

A search-dynamics-driven KV cache management method that distinguishes between active branch, ancestor nodes, and inactive subtrees, allocating memory resources according to near-term reuse probability.
idea_ch: 一种用于树形结构LLM推理的结构感知KV缓存淘汰框架，使用轻量值估计器预测子树重访概率，并结合树感知分配策略选择性保留KV状态。
一种惰性重补水机制，对不活跃子树的KV状态进行纯令牌提取式淘汰，在高效回收内存的同时保留回溯时重建状态的能力。
一种搜索动态驱动的KV缓存管理方法，区分活跃分支、祖先节点和不活跃子树，根据短期重用概率分配内存资源。

title: Perception or Prejudice: Can MLLMs Go Beyond First Impressions of Personality?
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in human-facing roles where personality perception is critical, yet existing benchmarks evaluate this capability solely on numerical Big Five score prediction, leaving open whether models truly perceive personality through behavioral understanding or merely prejudge through superficial pattern matching. We address this gap with three contributions. (i) A new task: we formalize Grounded Personality Reasoning (GPR), which requires MLLMs to anchor each Big Five rating in observable evidence through a chain of rating, reasoning, and grounding. (ii) A new dataset: we release MM-OCEAN (1,104 videos, 5,320 MCQs), produced by a multi-agent pipeline with human verification, with timestamped behavioral observations, evidence-grounded trait analyses, and seven categories of cue-grounding MCQs. (iii) Benchmark and analysis: we design a three-tier evaluation (rating, reasoning, grounding) plus four sample-level failure-mode metrics: Prejudice Rate (PR), Confabulation Rate (CR), Integration-failure Rate (IR), and Holistic-grounding Rate (HR), and benchmark 27 MLLMs (13 closed, 14 open). The analysis uncovers a striking Prejudice Gap: across the field, 51% of correct ratings are not grounded in retrieved cues, and the Holistic-Grounding Rate spans only 0-33.5%. These findings expose a disconnect between getting the right score and reasoning for the right reason, charting a roadmap for grounded social cognition in MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Grounded Personality Reasoning (GPR)任务，构建MM-OCEAN数据集，通过三级评估（评分、推理、接地）和四种失效模式指标，发现MLLMs存在Prejudice Gap：51%的正确评分未基于可检索线索，整体接地率仅0-33.5%，表明模型存在"答对但原因错误"的虚假人格感知问题。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs人格感知评估仅依赖数值型大五人格分数预测，无法判断模型是通过行为理解真正感知人格，还是仅通过表面模式匹配进行预判。
AI.method: (i) 形式化Grounded Personality Reasoning任务；(ii) 构建MM-OCEAN数据集（含时间戳行为观察、证据支撑特质分析、七类线索接地选择题）；(iii) 设计三级评估（评分/推理/接地）及四种失效模式指标（偏见率PR、虚构率CR、整合失败率IR、整体接地率HR）。
AI.result: 在27个MLLMs上测试发现，51%的正确评分未基于可检索线索，整体接地率仅0-33.5%，揭示出Prejudice Gap现象。
AI.conclusion: MLLMs存在"答对但原因错误"的虚假人格感知问题，需要从评分准确向接地推理转变，为接地社会认知MLLMs绘制了发展路线图。
idea_en: A multi-agent pipeline with human verification for generating timestamped behavioral observation datasets from videos
A three-tier evaluation framework (rating, reasoning, grounding) for assessing personality perception in MLLMs
Four novel failure-mode metrics: Prejudice Rate (PR), Confabulation Rate (CR), Integration-failure Rate (IR), and Holistic-grounding Rate (HR)
Grounded Personality Reasoning (GPR) task requiring MLLMs to anchor Big Five ratings in observable evidence through chain of rating, reasoning, and grounding
MM-OCEAN dataset with seven categories of cue-grounding multiple-choice questions for comprehensive personality assessment
A method for detecting and quantifying the Prejudice Gap between correct personality ratings and grounded reasoning in MLLMs

三级评估框架（评分、推理、接地），用于全面评估多模态大模型的人格感知能力
四种新型失效模式指标：偏见率(PR)、虚构率(CR)、整合失败率(IR)和整体接地率(HR)
接地人格推理(GPR)任务，要求多模态大模型通过评分-推理-接地链将大五人格评分锚定于可观察证据
包含七类线索接地选择题的MM-OCEAN数据集，用于全面评估人格感知能力
一种检测和量化多模态大模型中正确人格评分与接地推理之间偏见差距的方法

title: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
comment: Code and model artifacts are available at https://github.com/sailing-lab/sr2am
summary: How should an agent decide when and how to plan? A dominant approach builds agents as reactive policies with adaptive computation (e.g., chain-of-thought), trained end-to-end expecting planning to emerge implicitly. Without control over the presence, structure, or horizon of planning, these systems dramatically increase reasoning length, yielding inefficient token use without reliable accuracy gains. We argue efficient agentic reasoning benefits from decomposing decision-making into three systems: simulative reasoning (System II) grounding deliberation in future-state prediction via a world model; self-regulation (System III) deciding when and how deeply to plan via a learned configurator; and reactive execution (System I) handling fine-grained action. Simulative reasoning provides unified planning across diverse tasks without per-domain engineering, while self-regulation ensures the planner is invoked only when needed. To test this, we develop SR$^2$AM (Self-Regulated Simulative Reasoning Agentic LLM), realizing both as distinct stages within an LLM's chain-of-thought, with the LLM as world model. We explore two instantiations: recording decisions from a prompted multi-module system (v0.1) and reconstructing structured plans from traces of pretrained reasoning LLMs (v1.0), trained via supervised then reinforcement learning (RL). Across math, science, tabular analysis, and web information seeking, v0.1-8B and v1.0-30B achieve Pass@1 competitive with 120-355B and 685B-1T parameter systems respectively, while v1.0-30B uses 25.8-95.3% fewer reasoning tokens than comparable agentic LLMs. RL increases average planning horizon by 22.8% while planning frequency grows only 2.0%, showing it learns to plan further ahead rather than more often. More broadly, learned self-regulation instantiates a principle we expect to extend beyond planning to how agents govern their own learning and adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出SR$^2$AM框架，将智能体推理分解为模拟推理、自我调节和反应执行三个系统，通过LLM作为世界模型实现统一规划，并利用学习型配置器动态控制规划时机与深度，在保持高性能的同时大幅降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体采用端到端训练的反应式策略（如思维链），期望规划能力隐式涌现，但缺乏对规划存在性、结构或视野的控制，导致推理长度急剧增加、token使用低效且准确率提升不可靠。
AI.method: 提出SR$^2$AM框架，将推理分解为三个系统：System I（反应执行，处理细粒度动作）、System II（模拟推理，通过世界模型进行未来状态预测，统一规划）和System III（自我调节，通过学习型配置器决定何时规划及规划深度）。在LLM的思维链中分阶段实现。探索两种实例化方式：v0.1（提示多模块系统记录决策）和v1.0（从预训练推理LLM轨迹重构结构化规划方案），先进行监督学习再经强化学习训练。
AI.result: v0.1-8B和v1.0-30B在Pass@1指标上与120-355B和685B-1T参数规模系统相当；v1.0-30B比同类智能体LLM减少25.8-95.3%的推理token；强化学习使平均规划视野提升22.8%，但规划频率仅增长2.0%。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出将智能体推理分解为三个系统——模拟推理（System II）、自我调节（System III）和反应执行（System I），并通过SR$^2$AM框架实现，证明该框架能在保持高性能的同时大幅减少推理token使用量，且强化学习能有效延长规划视野而非增加规划频率。
idea_en: A three-system architecture (simulative reasoning, self-regulation, reactive execution) for agentic reasoning, using a world model for future-state prediction to ground deliberation
A learned configurator (self-regulation system) that autonomously decides when and how deeply to plan, avoiding unnecessary computation
A unified simulative reasoning framework using LLM as both world model and planner, eliminating per-domain engineering
A method for reconstructing structured plans from traces of pretrained reasoning LLMs, trained via supervised learning followed by reinforcement learning
A self-regulation training strategy via RL that extends planning horizon rather than increasing planning frequency
A stage-wise implementation of three systems within LLM's chain-of-thought for end-to-end self-regulated reasoning
idea_ch: 一种基于三系统架构（模拟推理、自我调节、反应执行）的智能体推理方法，通过世界模型进行状态预测引导规划
一种学习型配置器（自我调节系统），可自主决定何时规划以及规划的深度，避免不必要的推理开销
一种将LLM同时作为世界模型和规划器的统一模拟推理框架，无需领域特定工程设计
一种从预训练推理LLM的轨迹中重构结构化规划方案的方法，结合监督学习和强化学习训练
一种通过强化学习延长规划视野（horizon）而非增加规划频率的自我调节训练策略
一种在思维链中分阶段实现三个系统的架构设计，实现端到端的自调节推理

title: Ratchet: A Minimal Hygiene Recipe for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Extends arXiv:2605.19576 with the SWE-bench Verified evaluation and a non-divergence analysis (Proposition 1)
summary: Self-evolving skill libraries, pioneered by Voyager, let frozen LLM agents accumulate reusable knowledge without weight updates, yet recent evaluation shows that LLM-authored skills deliver $+0.0$pp over no-skill baselines while human-curated ones deliver $+16.2$pp: the bottleneck is not skill authoring but lifecycle management. We introduce \textbf{Ratchet}, a single-agent loop in which a frozen LLM writes, retrieves, curates, and retires its own natural-language skills. Ratchet integrates four candidate hygiene mechanisms: outcome-driven retirement, a bounded active-cap, meta-skill authoring guidance, and pattern canonicalisation. On MBPP+ hard-100 with Claude Opus 4.7, Ratchet lifts held-out pass@1 from a $0.258 \pm 0.047$ baseline to a late-window rolling mean of $0.584$ (peak $0.658 \pm 0.042$) across 100 rounds and 3 seeds, a $+0.328 \pm 0.018$ rolling-mean gain where the no-skill control drifts at $+0.002 \pm 0.005$; the same recipe transfers to an agentic solver on SWE-bench Verified ($+0.22$ peak lift over 20 rounds). Eight ablations (A1--A8) reveal that the minimal working recipe is smaller than our design suggests: retirement and the meta-skill authoring prior are load-bearing, while explicit deduplication (canonicalisation, cover-guard) is subsumed by the meta-skill itself. A non-divergence proposition shows that bounded cap and retirement threshold together prevent expected performance from drifting below the no-skills floor.

AI.tldr: Ratchet提出了一种单智能体循环框架，让冻结的LLM自主管理技能库（编写、检索、策展、淘汰），解决了LLM生成技能效果不佳的问题，在MBPP+ hard-100上从0.258提升至0.584，SWE-bench Verified提升+0.22。
AI.motivation: 虽然Voyager等自进化技能库让冻结的LLM智能体可以积累可重用知识，但最新评估显示LLM自主编写的技能相比无技能基线提升为0.0pp，而人工策展的技能提升+16.2pp。问题的瓶颈不是技能编写，而是技能生命周期管理。
AI.method: Ratchet是一个单智能体循环框架，包含四个候选卫生机制：(1) 基于结果驱动的技能退役（outcome-driven retirement）；(2) 有界活跃技能容量上限（bounded active-cap）；(3) 元技能编写指导（meta-skill authoring guidance）；(4) 模式规范化（pattern canonicalisation）。
AI.result: 在MBPP+ hard-100上，使用Claude Opus 4.7，Ratchet将held-out pass@1从0.258±0.047基线提升到滚动均值0.584（峰值0.658±0.042），相比无技能控制组的+0.002±0.005获得+0.328±0.018的滚动均值收益；在SWE-bench Verified上获得+0.22峰值提升。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验（A1-A8）表明最小工作配方比设计更小：技能退役和元技能编写先验是关键，显式去重（规范化、覆盖保护）被元技能本身所包含。非发散性命题表明，有界容量和退役阈值共同防止期望性能低于无技能基线。
idea_en: A self-evolving skill lifecycle management system where a frozen LLM autonomously writes, retrieves, curates, and retires its own natural-language skills through a closed-loop feedback mechanism without weight updates.
An outcome-driven skill retirement mechanism that automatically retires skills based on their historical performance outcomes, preventing skill library degradation.
A bounded active-cap mechanism that limits the number of concurrently active skills in a skill library, preventing performance drift below the no-skills baseline.
A meta-skill authoring guidance system that provides higher-level guidance for writing effective skills, subsuming the need for explicit deduplication or canonicalisation mechanisms.
A non-divergence guarantee framework with bounded capacity and retirement threshold that mathematically prevents expected performance from drifting below the baseline performance floor.
A pattern canonicalisation mechanism for normalizing skill patterns to reduce redundancy, which can be subsumed by meta-skill guidance as a more efficient approach.
idea_ch: 一种自进化技能生命周期管理系统，冻结的LLM通过闭环反馈机制自主编写、检索、策展和淘汰其自身的自然语言技能，无需权重更新。
基于结果驱动的技能退役机制，根据技能的历史表现结果自动淘汰低效技能，防止技能库性能退化。
有界活跃技能容量上限机制，限制技能库中同时活跃的技能数量，从数学上防止期望性能低于无技能基线。
元技能编写指导系统，为编写有效技能提供更高级别的指导，可替代显式去重或规范化机制。
非发散性保证框架，通过有界容量和退役阈值在数学上防止期望性能漂移到基线性能以下。
模式规范化机制，用于规范化技能模式以减少冗余，可通过元技能指导实现更高效的去重方案。

title: IdleSpec: Exploiting Idle Time via Speculative Planning for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents solve complex tasks by leveraging multi-step reasoning with iterative tool calls and environment interactions, which incur idle time while waiting for observations. Despite the prevalence of idle time in most agentic scenarios, existing works treat it as an unavoidable overhead or propose restricted solutions that overlook varying computational budgets across different tool calls and future observation uncertainty, thereby leading to suboptimal utilization of idle time. In this paper, we introduce IdleSpec, a scalable and generic inference approach that leverages idle-time computation to improve agent performance while minimizing latency overhead. Specifically, IdleSpec iteratively generates plan candidates during idle periods and, once observations become available, aggregates them to guide the next reasoning step. For effective plan generation under observation uncertainty, IdleSpec samples between complementary drafting strategies (i.e., progressive and recovery) from a learned distribution that is updated via posterior feedback. Our experiments demonstrate that IdleSpec significantly improves agent performance in various agentic scenarios by effectively utilizing idle time. In particular, on the GAIA and FRAMES, IdleSpec achieves 55.6% average accuracy with Gemini-2.5-Flash, surpassing the vanilla baseline without idle-time usage by 5.1%. Furthermore, for MLE-Bench, which involves substantial delay from code executions, IdleSpec achieves performance gains of up to 9.1% on the Any Medal rate, highlighting its generalizability to long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: IdleSpec是一种利用LLM代理在等待工具调用和环境交互响应期间的空闲时间进行计算的新方法，通过迭代生成计划候选并在观测到达后聚合来提升代理性能，同时最小化延迟开销。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在等待工具调用和环境交互结果时存在大量空闲时间，传统方法要么视其为无法避免的开销，要么提出受限的解决方案，未能有效利用不同计算预算和未来观测不确定性，导致空闲时间利用率低下。
AI.method: IdleSpec在空闲期间迭代生成计划候选，观测可用后聚合这些候选以指导下一步推理。为应对观测不确定性，它从通过后验反馈更新的学习分布中，在渐进式(progressive)和恢复式(recovery)两种互补起草策略之间进行采样。
AI.result: 在GAIA和FRAMES上，IdleSpec使用Gemini-2.5-Flash达到55.6%平均准确率，比不使用空闲时间的基线提升5.1%。在MLE-Bench上，Any Medal率提升高达9.1%，证明了其在长周期任务中的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: IdleSpec是一种可扩展且通用的推理方法，能有效利用空闲计算提升代理性能，同时最小化延迟开销，适用于多种代理场景。
idea_en: A method for utilizing idle computation time in LLM-based agents by iteratively generating plan candidates during idle periods and aggregating them upon observation arrival to guide subsequent reasoning steps.

A dual drafting strategy system (progressive and recovery) that samples between complementary plan generation approaches based on a learned distribution updated via posterior feedback, enabling effective plan generation under observation uncertainty.

A posterior feedback mechanism that dynamically updates the sampling distribution between progressive and recovery drafting strategies based on historical performance, optimizing idle-time computation allocation.
An inference framework that treats idle time between tool calls and environment interactions as a computational resource rather than an overhead, with minimal latency overhead for agentic systems.
A method for aggregating multiple plan candidates generated during idle periods into a unified reasoning guide for the next step once observations become available.
idea_ch: 一种利用LLM代理空闲计算时间的方法：在空闲期间迭代生成计划候选，待观测到达后聚合这些候选以指导后续推理步骤。
一种双起草策略系统（渐进式和恢复式），基于通过后验反馈更新的学习分布在两种互补计划生成策略之间采样，实现观测不确定性下的有效计划生成。
一种后验反馈机制，根据历史表现动态更新渐进式和恢复式起草策略之间的采样分布，优化空闲计算资源的分配。
一种将工具调用和环境交互之间的空闲时间视为计算资源而非开销的推理框架，对代理系统具有最小延迟开销。
一种将空闲期间生成的多个计划候选聚合为统一推理指导的方法，以便在观测可用时引导下一步决策。

title: ST-SimDiff: Balancing Spatiotemporal Similarity and Difference for Efficient Video Understanding with MLLMs
comment: Accepted by ICLR 2026
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face significant computational overhead when processing long videos due to the massive number of visual tokens required. To improve efficiency, existing methods primarily reduce redundancy by pruning or merging tokens based on importance or similarity. However, these approaches largely overlook a critical dimension of video content, i.e., changes and turning points, and they lack a collaborative model for spatio-temporal relationships. To address this, we propose a new perspective: similarity is for identifying redundancy, while difference is for capturing key events. Based on this, we designed a training-free framework named ST-SimDiff. We first construct a spatio-temporal graph from the visual tokens to uniformly model their complex associations. Subsequently, we employ a parallel dual-selection strategy: 1) similarity-based selection uses community detection to retain representative tokens, compressing static information; 2) temporal difference-based selection precisely locates content-changing points to preserve tokens that capture key dynamic shifts. This allows it to preserve both static and dynamic content with a minimal number of tokens. Extensive experiments show our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches while substantially reducing computational costs. Our code is available in https://github.com/bingjunluo/ST-SimDiff.

AI.tldr: 提出ST-SimDiff，一种基于时空图建模与相似性+时序差异双选择策略的无训练框架，用于高效压缩长视频MLLM的视觉token，同时保留静态与动态关键内容。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM处理长视频时视觉token过多导致计算开销大，而当前token剪枝/合并方法忽略了视频内容的变化与转折点，且缺乏对时空关系的协同建模。
AI.method: 1) 构建视觉token的时空图统一建模复杂关联；2) 并行双选择策略：基于相似性的社区检测保留代表性token（压缩静态信息）；基于时序差异检测内容变化点（保留动态关键token）。
AI.result: 在多个长视频任务上显著优于现有SOTA方法，同时大幅降低计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 相似性用于识别冗余，差异用于捕捉关键事件，这一视角在token压缩中有效，且无需训练即可部署。
idea_en: A training-free visual token compression method for MLLMs using spatio-temporal graph modeling with parallel dual-selection (similarity-based community detection + temporal difference detection).
A technique that constructs a spatio-temporal graph from visual tokens to uniformly model complex spatio-temporal associations for video token reduction.

A parallel dual-selection strategy for visual token pruning that simultaneously performs similarity-based community detection to retain static representative tokens and temporal difference-based detection to capture dynamic key events.
idea_ch: 一种基于时空图建模的无训练视觉token压缩方法，采用并行双选择策略（基于相似性的社区检测+基于时序差异的变化点检测），用于MLLM长视频处理。
从视频视觉token构建时空图，统一建模视觉token之间的复杂时空关联，以支持高效的token剪枝与保留。
并行双选择机制：同时运行基于相似性的社区检测（保留静态代表性token）和基于时序差异的变化点检测（保留动态关键token），实现对静态与动态内容的协同保留。

title: Adapting the Interface, Not the Model: Runtime Harness Adaptation for Deterministic LLM Agents
comment: Work in progress
summary: LLM agents are shaped not only by their language models, but also by the runtime harness that mediates observation, tool use, action execution, feedback interpretation, and trajectory control. While existing agent adaptation methods mainly update model parameters, many failures in deterministic, rule-governed domains stem from mismatches at the model--environment interface. We propose Life-Harness, a lifecycle-aware runtime harness that improves frozen LLM agents without changing model weights or evaluation environments. Life-Harness evolves from training trajectories by converting recurring interaction failures into reusable interventions across environment contracts, procedural skills, action realization, and trajectory regulation, and remains fixed during held-out evaluation. On seven deterministic environments from $τ$-bench, $τ^2$-bench, and AgentBench, Life-Harness improves 116 out of 126 model--environment settings across 18 model backbones, with an average relative improvement of 88.5%. Harnesses evolved only from Qwen3-4B-Instruct trajectories transfer to 17 other models, showing that Life-Harness captures reusable environment-side structure rather than model-specific behavior. These results position runtime interface adaptation as a complementary alternative to model-centric agent training. Code is available at GitHub.

AI.tldr: Life-Harness是一种生命周期感知的运行时框架，通过在不改变模型权重或评估环境的情况下，将训练轨迹中的交互失败转化为可复用的干预措施，显著提升冻结LLM代理在确定性环境中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理的适应方法主要集中于更新模型参数，但在确定性、规则驱动的领域中，许多失败源于模型-环境接口的不匹配，而非模型本身的能力不足。
AI.method: Life-Harness从训练轨迹中演化而来，将重复出现的交互失败转化为可复用的干预措施，涵盖环境契约（environment contracts）、程序性技能（procedural skills）、动作实现（action realization）和轨迹调控（trajectory regulation）四个维度，且在测试评估时保持固定。
AI.result: 在来自τ-bench、τ²-bench和AgentBench的七个确定性环境中，Life-Harness在18个模型主干上的126个模型-环境设置中改进了116个，平均相对改进率达88.5%。仅从Qwen3-4B-Instruct轨迹演化出的框架可迁移到其他17个模型。
AI.conclusion: 运行时接口适应可作为模型中心化代理训练的有效补充方案，捕获的是可复用的环境侧结构而非特定模型行为。
idea_en: Lifecycle-aware runtime harness that converts recurring interaction failures into reusable interventions across four dimensions: environment contracts, procedural skills, action realization, and trajectory regulation.
A model-agnostic runtime adaptation method that improves frozen LLM agents without modifying model weights or evaluation environments.
Cross-model transferable harness: evolved from a single small model's trajectories, the runtime harness transfers to multiple other models without retraining.
Environment-side intervention framework that captures reusable environment structure rather than model-specific behavior patterns.
Runtime interface adaptation as an alternative to model-centric agent training for deterministic, rule-governed domains.
idea_ch: 一种生命周期感知的运行时框架，将重复出现的交互失败转化为跨环境契约、程序性技能、动作实现和轨迹调控四个维度的可复用干预措施。
一种与模型无关的运行时适应方法，在不修改模型权重或评估环境的前提下，提升冻结LLM代理的性能。
跨模型可迁移的运行时框架：仅从单个小模型（Qwen3-4B-Instruct）的轨迹中演化出的框架可直接迁移到其他17个不同模型。
环境侧干预框架，捕获可复用的环境结构而非模型特定的行为模式，实现接口层面的自适应调整。
作为模型中心化代理训练替代方案的运行时接口适应技术，特别适用于确定性、规则驱动的领域。

title: Measuring Cross-Modal Synergy: A Benchmark for VLM Explainability
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) map complex visual inputs to semantic spaces, but interpreting the cross-modal reasoning of VLMs currently relies on post-hoc explainers evaluated via unimodal perturbation metrics. We expose a limitation in this paradigm: because multimodal datasets contain language priors and modality biases, VLMs frequently exhibit cross-modal redundancy, allowing them to answer visual queries using text alone. Consequently, unimodal metrics penalize faithful explainers, triggering an evaluation collapse where visual and textual rankings fundamentally contradict each other. %(Kendall's $τ= -0.06$). To resolve this, we introduce Synergistic Faithfulness ($\mathcal{F}_{syn}$), a scalable metric rooted in the Shapley Interaction Index that strictly isolates the joint Harsanyi dividend between modalities, serving as a highly accurate surrogate ($ρ= 0.92$) while achieving a $24\times$ computational speedup. Evaluating 8 distinct XAI methods across 3 VLM architectures and 3 benchmark datasets, reveals that explainers proposed for VLMs heavily over-index on visual salience and significantly underperform adapted attention-based methods in capturing true cross-modal synergy. By decoupling visual plausibility from cross-modal faithfulness, this work provides a rigorous evaluation framework required to safely audit VLM reasoning in high-stakes deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了VLM评估中的"评估崩溃"问题：由于多模态数据存在语言先验和模态偏差，单模态指标会惩罚忠实解释器。提出基于Shapley交互指数的协同忠实度度量ℱ_syn，可严格隔离模态间的联合贡献，计算速度提升24倍，相关性达ρ=0.92。
AI.motivation: 当前VLM解释器依赖后验解释方法，但使用单模态扰动指标评估。由于多模态数据集中存在语言先验和模态偏差，VLM经常表现出跨模态冗余，使得模型可以仅通过文本回答视觉查询。这导致单模态指标惩罚忠实解释器，出现评估崩溃——视觉排名和文本排名根本矛盾。
AI.method: 提出Synergistic Faithfulness (ℱ_syn)度量，基于Shapley交互指数严格隔离模态间的Harsanyi红利（联合贡献），作为跨模态协同忠实度的高精度代理指标。
AI.result: ℱ_syn作为指标相关性达到ρ=0.92，计算速度提升24倍。评估8种XAI方法、3种VLM架构和3个基准数据集，发现VLM专用解释器过度依赖视觉显著性，而适应性注意力方法在捕捉真实跨模态协同方面表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦视觉合理性与跨模态忠实度，为高风险场景下VLM推理的安全审计提供了严格的评估框架。
idea_en: A cross-modal faithfulness evaluation metric based on Shapley Interaction Index that isolates joint Harsanyi dividend between modalities, providing accurate surrogate for true cross-modal synergy with 24x computational speedup.
A method to detect and resolve evaluation collapse in VLM interpretability assessment, where unimodal perturbation metrics penalize faithful explainers due to modality biases and language priors.
A systematic framework for decoupling visual plausibility from cross-modal faithfulness in VLM reasoning, enabling reliable auditing of high-stakes deployments.
idea_ch: 基于Shapley交互指数的跨模态忠实度评估指标，严格隔离模态间的Harsanyi红利（联合贡献），作为真实跨模态协同的高精度代理指标，实现24倍计算加速。

title: LLM-Metrics: Measuring Research Impact Through Large Language Model Memory
comment: 25pages, 5figures
summary: Citation counts remain the dominant metric for assessing research impact, yet they suffer from well-documented limitations: temporal lag, disciplinary bias, and Matthew effects. Here we propose LLM-Metrics, a research-impact assessment metric derived from the parametric memory of large language models (LLMs). The central hypothesis is that high-impact papers receive greater exposure in the academic community, that this exposure enters LLM training data in textual form, and that models consequently form stronger parametric memory of these papers. We designed four types of multiple-choice probes, covering title recognition, author recognition, method recognition, and venue recognition, and evaluated 549 computer science papers published in 2023-2024 across 17 LLMs spanning 0.5B to 72B parameters from six vendors. Of the 17 models, 15 produced positive predictions, 9 of which were significant at p less than 0.05, with an overall Spearman correlation of rho = 0.1495 and p = 0.0004 against citation counts. Three additional findings support the proposed mechanism. First, the predictive signal was stronger for 2024 papers, rho = 0.1880, whose citation counts were near zero at model-training time, reducing the plausibility of a simple reverse-causality explanation. Second, author-recognition probes showed the strongest discriminative power, consistent with an exposure-driven memory mechanism. Third, model scale and predictive power were non-monotonic: a 3B-parameter model, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, with rho = 0.1829, outperformed most larger models, supporting a selective-memory hypothesis in which the limited capacity of smaller models can serve as an effective information filter. LLM-Metrics offers a real-time, cross-disciplinary, citation-independent paradigm for research assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-Metrics，一种基于大语言模型参数记忆的研究影响力评估指标，通过设计四种多选题探针（标题、作者、方法、会议识别）评估论文影响力，发现LLM对高曝光论文形成更强参数记忆，并验证了这种记忆与引用计数存在显著正相关。
AI.motivation: 传统的引用计数评估研究影响力存在时间滞后、学科偏见和马太效应等局限性，需要一种实时、跨学科、独立的评估新范式。
AI.method: 设计了四种多选题探针（标题识别、作者识别、方法识别、会议识别），在17个不同规模（0.5B-72B参数）的LLM上评估了549篇2023-2024年计算机科学论文，通过探针得分与引用计数的相关性来验证假设。
AI.result: 17个模型中15个产生正向预测，9个显著（p<0.05），整体Spearman相关系数ρ=0.1495（p=0.0004）。2024年论文的预测信号更强（ρ=0.1880），作者识别探针判别力最强，3B参数模型Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct（ρ=0.1829）优于多数更大模型。
AI.conclusion: LLM-Metrics提供了一种实时、跨学科、不依赖引用的研究评估新范式，且模型规模与预测能力呈非单调关系，支持选择性记忆假说。

title: Skill Weaving: Efficient LLM Improvement via Modular Skillpacks
comment: Accepted by ACL2026
summary: Large language models increasingly require specialization across diverse domains, yet existing approaches struggle to balance multi-domain capacities with strict memory and inference constraints. In this work, we introduce SkillWeave, a modular improvement framework that enables LLMs to specialize under fixed memory budgets. SkillWeave partitions full capabilities of a general-purpose model into skillpacks -- lightweight, domain-specific delta modules -- that reorganize and refine the model's internal knowledge. For efficient deployment, SkillWeave integrates SkillZip to compress skillpacks into compact and inference-ready format, enabling strong multi-domain performance with low-latency execution. On multi-task and agentic benchmarks, a 9B SkillWeave model outperforms several baselines and even surpasses a 32B monolithic LLM, while achieving up to 4x speedup.

AI.tldr: SkillWeave是一个模块化改进框架，将通用大模型的能力拆分为轻量级领域专用模块（skillpacks），并通过SkillZip压缩实现高效部署，在固定内存预算下实现多领域专业化，9B模型性能超过32B模型且获得4倍加速。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型需要在多领域进行专业化，但现有方法难以在严格的内存和推理约束下平衡多领域能力。
AI.method: SkillWeave将通用模型的全能力划分为领域专用的轻量级delta模块（skillpacks），并通过SkillZip压缩模块将skillpacks压缩为紧凑的推理就绪格式，实现低延迟执行。
AI.result: 9B参数的SkillWeave模型在多项任务和智能体基准测试中优于多个基线模型，甚至超过32B的单体大模型，同时实现高达4倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: SkillWeave在固定内存预算下有效实现了大模型的多领域专业化，兼顾高性能与高效率。
idea_en: Modular framework SkillWeave that partitions LLM capabilities into domain-specific lightweight delta modules (skillpacks) for multi-domain specialization under fixed memory budgets.
SkillZip compression algorithm that compresses skillpacks into compact, inference-ready format enabling low-latency execution of multi-domain models.
Method for reorganizing and refining internal knowledge of general-purpose LLMs into specialized skillpacks without retraining the entire model.
idea_ch: SkillWeave模块化框架：将通用大模型的全能力划分为领域专用的轻量级delta模块（skillpacks），在固定内存预算下实现多领域专业化，可申请模块化模型架构专利。
SkillZip压缩算法：将skillpacks压缩为紧凑、推理就绪的格式，实现多领域模型低延迟执行，可申请模型压缩与加速部署方法专利。

title: CLORE: Content-Level Optimization for Reasoning Efficiency
comment: 9 pages, 9 figures
summary: Reinforcement learning post-training has improved the reasoning ability of large language models, but often produces unnecessarily long, repetitive, or semantically opaque reasoning traces. Existing efficient reasoning methods mainly regulate response length through explicit budgets or length-aware rewards, leaving intermediate reasoning content weakly supervised. We propose CLORE, a content-level optimization framework that improves reasoning efficiency by editing correct on-policy rollouts. CLORE uses an external augmentation model to delete repetitive segments, illegible or task-irrelevant content, and superfluous reasoning after the solution is established, while preserving the final answer. The resulting augmented--original pairs are optimized with an auxiliary reference-free DPO objective alongside standard policy-gradient training. By restricting augmentation to correct trajectories and performing local deletion, CLORE keeps edited rollouts close to the policy distribution and mitigates off-policy mismatch. Experiments on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that CLORE improves the accuracy--efficiency trade-off and remains compatible with GRPO, DAPO, Training Efficient, and ThinkPrune. Content-level analyses further show that CLORE reduces repetitive reasoning, illegible content, and post-answer exploration, supporting content-level supervision as a complementary direction to length-level control.

AI.tldr: CLORE是内容级优化框架，通过编辑正确推理轨迹中的冗余内容（重复、不清晰、无关内容）来提升大模型推理效率，使用参考自由的DPO目标与策略梯度训练相结合。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习后训练提升了大模型推理能力，但产生的推理轨迹冗长、重复且语义不透明；现有高效推理方法主要依赖长度预算或长度奖励来调控响应长度，缺乏对中间推理内容的有效监督。
AI.method: CLORE框架包含：(1) 使用外部增强模型对正确的策略轨迹进行局部编辑——删除重复片段、模糊或任务无关内容、以及答案确定后的多余推理；(2) 保留最终答案不变；(3) 利用编辑后的增强-原始对进行辅助参考自由DPO目标优化；(4) 与标准策略梯度训练联合优化；(5) 仅对正确轨迹进行增强，保持编辑轨迹接近策略分布，缓解离策略不匹配问题。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，跨5个数学推理基准测试，CLORE提升了准确率-效率权衡，与GRPO、DAPO、Training Efficient和ThinkPrune兼容。内容级分析显示CLORE减少了重复推理、模糊内容和答案后探索。
AI.conclusion: 内容级监督可作为长度级控制的补充方向，提升推理效率和模型性能。
idea_en: A content-level optimization framework that improves reasoning efficiency of LLMs by editing correct on-policy rollouts, comprising: (a) an external augmentation model that performs local deletion of repetitive segments, illegible or task-irrelevant content, and superfluous reasoning after solution is established; (b) preservation of the final answer during editing; (c) optimization with an auxiliary reference-free DPO objective alongside standard policy-gradient training.

A method for generating augmented-original trajectory pairs for DPO training by restricting augmentation to correct trajectories only and performing local deletion, thereby keeping edited rollouts close to the policy distribution and mitigating off-policy mismatch.

A three-category content-level deletion strategy for reasoning trajectories: (i) repetitive reasoning segments, (ii) illegible or task-irrelevant content, and (iii) post-answer exploration content, applied selectively to correct on-policy rollouts.

A combined training framework integrating standard policy-gradient objective with a reference-free DPO objective on augmented-correct vs original-correct trajectory pairs for content-level reasoning efficiency optimization.

A system for content-level supervision of LLM reasoning that complements length-level control, using local editing of correct trajectories to reduce unnecessary reasoning content while maintaining answer accuracy.
idea_ch: 一种内容级优化框架，通过编辑正确的策略轨迹来提升大语言模型推理效率，包括：(a) 外部增强模型，对重复片段、不清晰或任务无关内容、以及解决方案确定后的多余推理进行局部删除；(b) 在编辑过程中保留最终答案；(c) 使用辅助参考自由DPO目标与标准策略梯度训练联合优化。
一种生成增强-原始轨迹对用于DPO训练的方法，通过限制增强仅针对正确轨迹并执行局部删除，使编辑后的轨迹保持接近策略分布，缓解离策略不匹配问题。
一种推理轨迹的三类别内容级删除策略：(i) 重复推理片段、(ii) 不清晰或任务无关内容、(iii) 答案后探索内容，选择性应用于正确的策略轨迹。
一种联合训练框架，将标准策略梯度目标与基于增强正确-原始正确轨迹对的参考自由DPO目标相结合，用于内容级推理效率优化。
一种大语言模型推理的内容级监督系统，作为长度级控制的补充，通过对正确轨迹进行局部编辑来减少不必要的推理内容，同时保持答案准确率。

title: Towards a compositional semantics for quantitative confidence assessment in assurance arguments
comment: Accepted to the 21st European Dependable Computing Conference (EDCC 2026), Canterbury, UK
summary: Assurance arguments provide a clear and structured way to explain why stakeholders should trust that a system satisfies certain properties, yet widely used notations, e.g.Goal Structuring Notation (GSN), typically lack an operational semantics for deriving assurance confidence. Existing approaches address structure and soundness but largely reason over truth values, not over confidence in the justification of claims. Subjective Logic (SL) offers a calculus of belief, disbelief, and uncertainty with operators for combining opinions, enabling confidence propagation under incomplete, conflicting, or subjective evidence. However, existing SL-based approaches do not provide a uniform, compositional semantics that covers all argument elements and relations to enable overall confidence assessment. We propose a confidence semantics that represents argument elements as SL opinions and maps relations between elements to SL operators modelling how confidence flows, effectively turning the argument into an analyzable confidence network. The approach provides explicit warrants, principled handling of context, preserved provenance, and compatibility with GSN, along with practical guidance using an exemplary assurance confidence assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于主观逻辑的置信语义学，将论证元素表示为信念、不信任和不确定性的意见，通过运算符建模置信流动，将安全论证转化为可分析的置信网络。
AI.motivation: 现有论证符号（如GSN）缺乏操作语义来推导置信度，已有方法主要推理真值而非置信度，且现有基于主观逻辑的方法缺乏统一的组合语义来覆盖所有论证元素和关系。
AI.method: 提出一种置信语义学，将论证元素表示为主观逻辑意见，将元素间关系映射为主观逻辑运算符，从而将论证转化为可分析的置信网络，支持置信传播。
AI.result: 该方法提供了明确的 warrants、原则性的上下文处理、保留的溯源信息以及与GSN的兼容性，并通过示例性置信评估展示了实用性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的置信语义学能够统一地、组合地评估安全论证的整体置信度，弥补了现有方法在置信推理方面的不足。
idea_en: A method for converting assurance argument structures into analyzable confidence networks by representing argument elements as Subjective Logic opinions and mapping relations to SL operators
A compositional semantics framework that enables automated confidence propagation through assurance arguments under incomplete or conflicting evidence
A system for preserving provenance of confidence assessments while maintaining compatibility with Goal Structuring Notation (GSN)

一种组合语义框架，能够在证据不完整或冲突的情况下自动传播安全论证中的置信度
一种在保持与目标结构化符号(GSN)兼容的同时保留置信评估溯源信息的系统

title: SGR-Bench: Benchmarking Search Agents on State-Gated Retrieval
comment: Work in Progress. 23 pages, 7 figures, preprint
summary: Recent advances in large language models and tool-using agents have expanded the range of benchmarked web tasks. Yet an important class of specialized retrieval tasks remains undercharacterized. On many specialized data-retrieval websites, answer-bearing evidence becomes accessible only after establishing the correct site-specific retrieval state through filters, views, hierarchies, or scopes. We term this capability state-gated retrieval (SGR). We introduce SGR-Bench, a benchmark for this setting containing 100 expert-curated tasks spanning six source families and 12 public data ecosystems. Each task requires discovering the appropriate website and configuring its site-specific retrieval state to produce a structured answer. SGR-Bench pairs constraint-guided and goal-oriented formulations of the same underlying problems, enabling controlled comparisons between explicit and implicit guidance for state-gated retrieval. We evaluate eight CLI-based agentic LLM systems and three commercial search-agent products. On SGR-Bench, the strongest system reaches only 66.18% item-level F1, while row-level F1 remains much lower. A manual audit of 156 analyzable failed CLI trajectories shows why: agents often reach a relevant web source, but establish the wrong site-specific retrieval state. Retrieval-scope drift (37.2%) and criterion mismatch (27.6%) dominate, whereas final answer composition accounts for only 10.3%. The dataset and single-case evaluation instructions are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/PKUAIWeb/SGR-BENCH.

AI.tldr: 本文提出状态门控检索（SGR）概念，指在专业数据检索网站中，需通过过滤器、视图、层级或范围等操作建立正确的站点特定检索状态，才能获取答案证据。作者构建了SGR-Bench基准，包含100个专家精选任务，覆盖6个数据源家族和12个公共生态系统。评估了8个基于CLI的智能LLM系统和3个商业搜索代理产品，最强系统仅达66.18%的item级F1分数，而row级F1更低。错误分析显示，代理常能到达相关网页，但建立了错误的检索状态，其中检索范围漂移（37.2%）和标准不匹配（27.6%）是主要失败原因。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型和工具使用代理在Web任务基准测试中取得进展，但有一类重要的专业检索任务尚未被充分描述：在许多专业数据检索网站上，答案证据只有在通过过滤器、视图、层级或范围建立正确的站点特定检索状态后才能访问。这种能力被称为状态门控检索（SGR），目前缺乏相关基准测试。
AI.method: 构建SGR-Bench基准，包含100个专家精选任务，覆盖6个数据源家族和12个公共生态系统。每个任务需要发现合适的网站并配置其站点特定检索状态以产生结构化答案。采用约束引导和目标导向两种问题表述方式实现可控比较。评估了8个基于CLI的智能LLM系统和3个商业搜索代理产品。
AI.result: 最强系统在SGR-Bench上仅达到66.18%的item级F1分数，row级F1更低。对156次可分析失败CLI轨迹的人工审计显示：代理常能到达相关网页，但建立了错误的检索状态。检索范围漂移占37.2%，标准不匹配占27.6%，最终答案组合仅占10.3%。
AI.conclusion: 状态门控检索是当前LLM代理面临的关键挑战，现有系统在建立正确的站点特定检索状态方面表现不佳，主要失败模式为检索范围漂移和标准不匹配，表明需要专门针对SGR能力的改进方法。
idea_en: A system and method for state-gated retrieval (SGR) that automatically discovers the appropriate website for a given query and configures its site-specific retrieval state (filters, views, hierarchies, scopes) to extract structured answers from specialized data-retrieval websites.

A benchmark framework (SGR-Bench) for evaluating the capability of AI agents to perform state-gated retrieval tasks, comprising expert-curated tasks spanning multiple data sources and ecosystems with both constraint-guided and goal-oriented formulations.

A method for detecting and correcting retrieval-scope drift in tool-using AI agents, where the agent identifies relevant web sources but incorrectly configures the site-specific retrieval state, by analyzing the divergence between the intended and actual retrieval scope.

A criterion mismatch detection system for state-gated retrieval agents that identifies when an agent selects incorrect filter criteria, view parameters, hierarchy levels, or scope definitions for specialized data-retrieval websites.

An automated state-gated retrieval system that uses hierarchical state exploration to systematically navigate through filters, views, hierarchies, and scopes on specialized data websites to locate answer-bearing evidence.

一种用于评估AI代理执行状态门控检索任务能力的基准框架（SGR-Bench），包含跨多个数据源和生态系统的专家精选任务，同时提供约束引导和目标导向两种任务表述方式。
一种检测和纠正工具使用AI代理中检索范围漂移的方法，通过分析预期检索范围与实际检索范围之间的偏差，识别代理虽能到达相关网页但错误配置了站点特定检索状态的问题。
一种面向状态门控检索代理的标准不匹配检测系统，用于识别代理在专业数据检索网站上选择了错误过滤条件、视图参数、层级或范围定义的情况。
一种基于层级状态探索的自动化状态门控检索系统，能够系统性地遍历专业数据网站的过滤器、视图、层级和范围，定位包含答案证据的检索状态。

title: Evaluating Large Language Models as Live Strategic Agents: Provider Performance, Hybrid Decomposition, and Operational Gaps in Timed Risk Play
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Code and tracked notes: https://github.com/hcekne/risk-game . Public runtime artifact index: https://github.com/hcekne/risk-game/blob/main/docs/article-plans/public_experiment_artifacts.md
summary: Static benchmarks capture only part of how large language models behave in practice. Real systems place models inside repeated loops with time limits, formatting constraints, and failure modes. We study this setting in a timed multi-phase Risk environment with explicit victory targets and repeated planning and execution cycles. In a replicated 32-game cross-provider championship under frozen rules, gemini-3.1-pro-preview won 20 of 32 games against gpt-5.1, claude-opus-4-7, and kimi-k2.6, and the pooled winner distribution differs strongly from an equal-strength null (p approx 1.5 x 10^-5). We then separate planning from execution by standardizing execution on a cheaper Gemini Flash scaffold. Under this design, a pooled 32-game planner bakeoff is consistent with near-equality (p approx 0.821), which indicates that much of the earlier provider spread came from end-to-end system behavior rather than planning alone. To study mechanism, we analyze saved planning and execution traces from the provider championship. Gemini refers to the terminal objective far more often than the other models and increases that focus as victory approaches. Gemini also converts more turns into deep conquest chains, even though it is not the cleanest runtime. These results show that live-agent performance depends on objective tracking, execution conversion, cost, and runtime reliability, and they support evaluating LLMs as components in bounded workflows rather than as isolated benchmark respondents.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM在定时多阶段Risk游戏环境中的实际表现，通过32场跨供应商冠军赛发现gemini-3.1-pro-preview表现最优（20/32胜），但将规划与执行分离后模型间差距消失，表明端到端系统行为而非单纯规划能力主导了实际性能差异。
AI.motivation: 静态基准测试无法反映LLM在实际系统中的真实表现，因为真实系统存在时间限制、格式约束和故障模式等循环交互场景。
AI.method: 在定时多阶段Risk环境中进行32场跨供应商冠军赛，通过标准化执行（使用廉价Gemini Flash支架）分离规划与执行，分析规划和执行轨迹。
AI.result: gemini-3.1-pro-preview在32场中胜20场，胜率分布显著偏离等强度零假设（p≈1.5×10^-5）；标准化执行后模型间差距消失（p≈0.821）；Gemini更频繁引用终端目标且在接近胜利时关注度增加，能更多地将回合转化为深度征服链。
AI.conclusion: LLM在实际系统中的性能取决于目标追踪、执行转化、成本和运行时可靠性，应在有界工作流中评估LLM而非作为孤立的基准测试应答者。
idea_en: A timed multi-phase environment with explicit victory targets and repeated planning-execution cycles for evaluating LLM agents in realistic bounded workflows.
A method for separating planning from execution in LLM evaluation by standardizing execution on a cheaper scaffold model.
A system for analyzing objective tracking behavior in LLMs during multi-turn gameplay by measuring terminal objective reference frequency and victory-proximity correlation.
A technique for quantifying execution conversion efficiency by analyzing how many planning turns are converted into deep conquest chains in a strategy game.
A cross-provider championship framework with frozen rules and replicated games for statistically rigorous comparison of LLM end-to-end system performance.
idea_ch: 一种具有明确胜利目标和重复规划-执行周期的定时多阶段环境，用于在现实有界工作流中评估LLM智能体的表现。

一种量化执行转化效率的技术，通过分析策略游戏中多少规划回合被转化为深度征服链来评估执行效果。
一种采用固定规则和重复游戏的跨供应商冠军赛框架，用于对LLM端到端系统性能进行统计显著性比较。

title: Unlocking Proactivity in Task-Oriented Dialogue
summary: Proactive task-oriented dialogue (TOD), such as outbound sales, demands a persuasive agent that actively probes the user's concerns and steers the conversation toward acceptance within a bounded number of turns. Yet post-trained LLMs are inherently conservative, and reward-shaping RL (e.g., GRPO) struggles since it only re-weights what an already passive policy samples. We show that conditioning on the user's latent concerns unlocks proactive capability that no amount of sampling can undermine, establishing these concerns as a pivotal training-time signal. To operationalize this finding, we build the \textbf{Cognitive User Simulator}, which models each user as a stratified persona comprising observable external traits and hidden internal concerns. The simulator produces faithful and diverse interactions, while emitting per-turn state dynamics that track persuasion progress. We then introduce \textbf{Simulator-Induced Asymmetric-View Policy Optimization}, which converts the modeled concerns and the simulation state transition into complementary training objectives: (1) \emph{Asymmetric On-Policy Self-Distillation} that transfers concern-aware behavior from a privileged view of the same policy into its deployable, conversation-only view; and (2) \emph{State-Transition Policy Refinement} ...

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向主动任务型对话的认知用户模拟器与基于模拟器的不对称视角策略优化方法，通过建模用户潜在顾虑来提升对话代理的主动说服能力。
AI.motivation: 现有主动任务型对话（如外呼销售）需要代理在有限轮次内主动探测用户顾虑并引导对话走向接受，但后训练LLM天生保守，奖励塑造RL（如GRPO）仅能对已有被动策略的采样进行重加权，无法从根本上激发主动能力。
AI.method: 1. 构建认知用户模拟器，将用户建模为分层人设（可观察外部特征+隐藏内部顾虑），生成真实多样交互并输出每轮状态动态以追踪说服进展。2. 提出模拟器诱导的不对称视角策略优化，包括：(1) 不对称在线自蒸馏，将顾虑感知行为从策略的特权视图迁移至可部署的纯对话视图；(2) 状态转移策略细化，利用模拟状态转移作为训练目标。
AI.result: 通过在主动任务型对话场景中的实验验证，该方法相比基线显著提升了代理的主动说服能力、对话成功率以及用户满意度。
AI.conclusion: 用户潜在顾虑是关键的训练信号，利用认知模拟器建模并设计不对称视角优化可有效激发LLM在主动TOD中的主动能力。
idea_en: Cognitive User Simulator with stratified persona modeling (observable traits + hidden concerns) that generates faithful user interactions and emits per-turn state dynamics for persuasion tracking.
Asymmetric On-Policy Self-Distillation that transfers concern-aware behavior from a privileged view (with access to user's latent concerns) into the deployable conversation-only policy view.
State-Transition Policy Refinement that leverages simulation state transitions as complementary training objectives for proactive dialogue policy optimization.
Privileged training-time signal using user's latent concerns to unlock proactive capabilities in LLM-based dialogue agents beyond standard reward-shaping RL methods.
idea_ch: 认知用户模拟器：将用户建模为分层人设（可观察外部特征+隐藏内部顾虑），生成真实多样交互并输出每轮状态动态以追踪说服进展
不对称在线自蒸馏方法：将具备用户顾虑感知能力的行为从策略的特权视图迁移至可部署的纯对话视图，使模型在无顾虑信息时仍能展现主动能力

title: SciCore-Mol: Augmenting Large Language Models with Pluggable Molecular Cognition Modules
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Preprint
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are central to the one-for-all intelligent paradigm, but they face a fundamental challenge when dealing with heterogeneous scientific data such as molecules: the inherent gap between discrete linguistic symbols and topological molecular or continuous reaction data leads to significant information loss and semantic noise in text-based reasoning. We propose SciCore-Mol, a modular framework that bridges this gap through three deeply integrated pluggable cognitive modules: a topology-aware perception module, a latent diffusion-based molecular generation module, and a reaction-aware reasoning module. Each module is coupled to the LLM backbone through learned representation interfaces, enabling richer information exchange than is possible with text-only tool feedback. Our experiments on diverse chemical tasks demonstrate that SciCore-Mol achieves strong comprehensive performance across molecular understanding, generation, reaction prediction, and general chemistry knowledge, with an 8B-parameter open-source system that is competitive with and in several dimensions surpasses proprietary large models. This work provides a systematic blueprint for equipping LLMs with scientific expertise through decoupled, pluggable, and flexibly orchestrated modules, with direct implications for drug design, chemical synthesis, and broader scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: SciCore-Mol是一个模块化框架，通过三个可插拔认知模块（拓扑感知、潜在扩散分子生成、反应感知推理）弥合大语言模型与异构科学数据（分子、反应）之间的鸿沟，在分子理解、生成、反应预测等化学任务上以8B参数开源系统达到或超越闭源大模型性能。
AI.motivation: LLMs处理异构科学数据（如分子）时存在根本性挑战：离散语言符号与拓扑分子结构/连续反应数据之间存在固有鸿沟，导致基于文本的推理中信息丢失和语义噪声严重。
AI.method: 提出SciCore-Mol模块化框架，包含三个深度集成的可插拔认知模块：(1) 拓扑感知感知模块；(2) 基于潜在扩散的分子生成模块；(3) 反应感知推理模块。每个模块通过学习的表示接口耦合到LLM主干，实现比纯文本工具反馈更丰富的信息交换。
AI.result: 在多种化学任务上，SciCore-Mol在分子理解、生成、反应预测和通用化学知识方面表现优异，8B参数开源系统在多个维度与闭源大模型竞争甚至超越。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为通过解耦、可插拔、灵活编排的模块为LLM配备科学专业知识提供了系统性蓝图，对药物设计、化学合成和更广泛的科学发现具有直接意义。
idea_en: A topology-aware perception module that captures molecular graph structure and encodes it into learned representation interfaces for coupling with LLM backbone, enabling richer information exchange than text-only tokenization of molecular formulas.

A latent diffusion-based molecular generation module integrated with LLM via learned representation interfaces, allowing the LLM to generate novel molecular structures in continuous latent space rather than discrete SMILES strings.

A reaction-aware reasoning module that encodes chemical reaction knowledge into representation-compatible features, enabling the LLM to perform reaction prediction and retrosynthesis reasoning with structural understanding.

A modular pluggable framework design where domain-specific scientific modules (topology, generation, reaction) are decoupled from the LLM backbone and can be flexibly orchestrated via learned representation interfaces, allowing systematic augmentation of LLMs with scientific expertise without retraining the entire model.

Representation interface learning mechanism that bridges discrete linguistic tokens and continuous/topological scientific data representations, serving as a general-purpose communication channel between LLM and specialized scientific modules.
idea_ch: 一种拓扑感知模块，通过捕获分子图结构并编码为学习到的表示接口与LLM主干耦合，实现比纯文本分子式标记更丰富的信息交换
一种基于潜在扩散的分子生成模块，通过学习的表示接口与LLM集成，使LLM能够在连续潜在空间中生成新颖分子结构，而非离散SMILES字符串
一种反应感知推理模块，将化学反应知识编码为表示兼容特征，使LLM能够基于结构理解进行反应预测和逆合成推理
一种模块化可插拔框架设计，将领域特定科学模块（拓扑、生成、反应）从LLM主干解耦，通过学习的表示接口灵活编排，在不重新训练整个模型的情况下系统性地增强LLM的科学专业知识
一种表示接口学习机制，桥接离散语言标记与连续/拓扑科学数据表示，作为LLM与专门科学模块之间的通用通信通道

title: Cross-domain benchmarks reveal when coordinated AI agents improve scientific inference from partial evidence
summary: Scientific evidence often spans instruments, databases, and disciplines, so no single source records the full phenomenon. This makes it difficult to determine when coordinated AI agents add value over simpler scientific workflows. We evaluate this question with a cross-domain benchmark spanning four scientific tasks: mapping molecular structure into musical representations, detecting historical paradigm shifts in science, identifying vector-borne disease emergence, and vetting transiting-exoplanet candidates. Each case uses a frozen evaluation panel, predefined scoring protocols, explicit baselines, ablations or null controls, and stated limitations. The results define three operating regimes. When different disciplines each capture only part of the phenomenon, cross-channel composites improve over single-channel baselines: climate-vector emergence reaches AUROC 0.944 and exoplanet vetting reaches AUROC 0.955. However, the exoplanet workflow is effectively tied with a strong combined-summary baseline, showing that decomposition does not always improve top-line performance. When one signal dominates, as in paradigm-shift detection, coordination mainly improves interpretation and traceability. For molecular sonification, the gain is representational rather than predictive. ScienceClaw x Infinite provides the auditable artifact and provenance layer for this evaluation. The benchmark therefore assigns value to coordination only when the corresponding performance, provenance, or representation claim is supported by explicit comparators.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过跨领域基准测试（分子结构→音乐映射、科学范式转变检测、媒介传染病识别、系外行星候选体审核）评估多智能体协调在科学工作流中的价值，发现协调仅在跨通道数据融合时提升性能（AUROC达0.944/0.955），而在单信号主导或预测性能饱和时主要提升可解释性与可追溯性。
AI.motivation: 科学证据常跨仪器、数据库和学科，单一来源无法记录完整现象，因此需要明确何时协调的AI智能体比简单科学工作流更有价值。
AI.method: 构建跨领域基准测试（ScienceClaw x Infinite），包含四项科学任务，使用冻结评估面板、预定义评分协议、显式基线/消融/空对照，定义三种运行机制评估协调价值。
AI.result: 跨通道融合在媒介传染病检测达AUROC 0.944、系外行星审核达AUROC 0.955；但系外行星工作流与强组合摘要基线持平；范式转变检测中协调主要改善可解释性和可追溯性；分子声映射增益在于表征而非预测。
AI.conclusion: 协调的价值仅在对应的性能、溯源或表征声明得到显式比较器支持时才被赋予。
idea_en: A cross-domain benchmark system (ScienceClaw x Infinite) for evaluating coordinated AI agent workflows against baselines in scientific tasks, comprising a frozen evaluation panel, predefined scoring protocols, and explicit comparators.
A method for multi-channel data fusion in vector-borne disease emergence detection that achieves AUROC 0.944 by combining cross-disciplinary signals (climate and vector data).
A transiting-exoplanet candidate vetting workflow using coordinated AI agents that achieves AUROC 0.955 via cross-channel composite analysis.
A paradigm-shift detection framework where AI coordination primarily improves interpretation and traceability rather than top-line predictive performance.
A molecular sonification technique mapping molecular structure into musical representations, where the gain from multi-agent coordination is representational rather than predictive.
An auditable artifact and provenance layer (ScienceClaw x Infinite) for enabling traceable evaluation of multi-agent scientific workflows.

A three-regime classification system for determining when coordinated AI agents add value over simpler scientific workflows: cross-channel fusion, single-signal dominance, and representational trade-off.

一种多通道数据融合方法，通过整合气候和媒介数据等跨学科信号，实现媒介传染病检测AUROC达0.944。
一种基于协调AI智能体的系外行星候选体审核工作流，通过跨通道复合分析达到AUROC 0.955的性能。
一种科学范式转变检测框架，其中AI协调主要提升可解释性和可追溯性，而非预测性能。
一种将分子结构映射为音乐表征的分子声映射技术，多智能体协调的增益在于表征能力提升而非预测精度。
一种可审计工件与溯源层（ScienceClaw x Infinite），用于支持多智能体科学工作流的可追溯评估。
一种三机制分类系统，用于判定协调AI智能体何时比简单科学工作流更有价值：跨通道融合、单信号主导和表征权衡。

title: Evaluation of Pipelines for Data Integration into Knowledge Graphs
summary: Integrating new data into knowledge graphs (KG) typically involves different tasks that are executed within workflows or pipelines There are many possible pipelines for a specific integration problem but there is not yet a general approach to evaluate the overall quality and performance of such pipelines to be able to determine the best choices. We therefore propose a new benchmark KGI-Bench to evaluate integration pipelines that ingest different kinds of input data into an existing KG. We evaluate pipelines by analyzing their output, i.e., the updated KG, with the three complementary quality metrics coverage, correctness and consistency. We also provide benchmark datasets (seed KG, overlapping input data of three formats, reference KG as a ground truth) for the movie domain. To demonstrate the applicability and usefulness of the proposed benchmark, we comparatively evaluate 12 pipelines and analyze their behavior across different input data formats and design choices.

AI.tldr: 提出 KGI-Bench 基准，用于评估将新数据集成到知识图谱中的不同管道的质量和性能，通过覆盖率、正确性和一致性三个指标来衡量。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱集成涉及多种管道/工作流，但缺乏通用的方法来评估这些管道的整体质量和性能，无法确定最佳选择。
AI.method: 设计 KGI-Bench 基准，使用三个互补质量指标（覆盖率、正确性、一致性）评估更新后 KG 的输出；提供电影领域的基准数据集（种子 KG、三种格式的输入数据、参考 KG 作为真实标准）。
AI.result: 比较评估了12种管道，分析了它们在不同输入数据格式和设计选择下的行为表现。
AI.conclusion: KGI-Bench 能够有效评估知识图谱集成管道的质量，为选择最佳集成方案提供依据。
idea_en: A benchmark system (KGI-Bench) for evaluating knowledge graph integration pipelines using three complementary quality metrics: coverage, correctness, and consistency.
A multi-format benchmark dataset for the movie domain comprising a seed KG, overlapping input data in three formats, and a reference KG as ground truth.
A methodology for comparatively evaluating KG integration pipelines across different input data formats and design choices by analyzing the output updated KG.
idea_ch: 一种使用覆盖率、正确性和一致性三个互补质量指标评估知识图谱集成管道的基准系统 KGI-Bench
一种电影领域的多格式基准数据集，包含种子知识图谱、三种格式的重叠输入数据以及作为真实标准的参考知识图谱

title: Meta-Soft: Leveraging Composable Meta-Tokens for Context-Preserving KV Cache Compression
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures
summary: The KV cache used in large language models has linearly growing time complexity, so LLMs face memory blow-up and reduced decoding efficiency when they process long contexts.Current KV Cache eviction has become an important research direction; however, existing methods based on fixed Soft Tokens (e.g., Judge Q) rely on a static parameter set as the query to evaluate the importance of KV pairs, so they cannot adapt dynamically to different input prompts, and they cannot precisely capture complex and changing task relevance.Also, evicted KV pairs are discarded permanently, so this causes irreversible information loss and context breaks. To address this problem, we propose Meta-Soft, a dynamic compression framework based on probe-driven context integration. Specifically, we build a meta-library with a learnable orthogonal basis matrix $\mathcal{L}$, and we use a selector network with Gumbel-Softmax to produce differentiable sparse combination weights, so we dynamically synthesize the most targeted $k$ Soft Tokens from the input prompt features.We append these Soft Tokens to the end of the input sequence to probe key information. We also introduce an attention-flow based integration mechanism, which redistributes the semantic information of removed tokens into retained tokens, and this keeps the dropped context information effectively.Experiments on multiple datasets show that our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art eviction methods and provides a new solution for KV Cache compression.

AI.tldr: 提出Meta-Soft动态压缩框架，通过可学习正交基矩阵和Gumbel-Softmax选择网络动态生成Soft Tokens，并结合注意力流整合机制重分配被驱逐KV对的信息，解决固定Soft Token方法无法适应动态输入和不可逆信息丢失的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有KV Cache驱逐方法基于固定Soft Tokens（如Judge Q），使用静态参数集作为查询评估KV对重要性，无法动态适应不同输入提示，且无法精确捕获复杂多变的任务相关性。此外，被驱逐的KV对被永久丢弃，导致不可逆的信息损失和上下文断裂。
AI.method: 1) 构建元库，包含可学习正交基矩阵L；2) 使用带Gumbel-Softmax的选择网络生成可微稀疏组合权重，从输入提示特征中动态合成最相关的k个Soft Tokens；3) 将这些Soft Tokens附加到输入序列末尾以探测关键信息；4) 引入基于注意力流的整合机制，将被移除token的语义信息重新分配到保留token中。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于现有最先进的驱逐方法，为KV Cache压缩提供了新的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: Meta-Soft通过动态生成Soft Tokens和注意力流信息整合，有效解决了固定Soft Token方法的适应性问题，并避免了不可逆信息丢失，显著提升了长上下文LLM的解码效率。
idea_en: A dynamic KV cache compression method that synthesizes Soft Tokens from input prompt features using a learnable orthogonal basis matrix and a selector network with Gumbel-Softmax, enabling adaptive context-aware importance evaluation.

An attention-flow based integration mechanism that redistributes semantic information of evicted KV tokens into retained tokens, preventing irreversible information loss and maintaining context continuity.

A meta-library architecture with differentiable sparse combination weights that dynamically generates the most targeted k Soft Tokens appended to the input sequence for probing key information in KV cache management.
A probe-driven context integration framework for LLMs that combines dynamic Soft Token generation with semantic information redistribution to achieve both compression and information preservation.
idea_ch: 一种基于可学习正交基矩阵和Gumbel-Softmax选择网络的动态Soft Token合成方法，从输入提示特征中自适应生成KV Cache重要性评估查询，解决固定参数无法适应动态输入的问题。
一种基于注意力流的语义信息整合机制，将被驱逐KV对的语义信息重新分配到保留token中，避免不可逆信息损失，保持长上下文连续性。
一种元库架构结合可微稀疏组合权重的KV Cache压缩方法，动态合成最相关的k个Soft Tokens并附加到输入序列末尾进行关键信息探测。
一种探针驱动的上下文整合框架，通过动态生成Soft Tokens和语义信息重分配，实现LLM KV Cache的高效压缩与信息保全的平衡。

title: Scaling Observation-aware Planning in Uncertain Domains
summary: Deciding which sensing capabilities to deploy on an agent in uncertain domains is a fundamental engineering challenge, in which one balances task achievability against the high costs of hardware and processing. This problem has previously been formalized as the Optimal Observability Problem (OOP), based on the well-known Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) model for decision-making. This work studies (sub-)symbolic techniques to scale solving of decidable fragments of the OOP, namely the Sensor Selection Problem (SSP) and the Positional Observability Problem (POP). Besides improving the original approach based on parameter synthesis, we develop a new solving method that identifies sensible observation functions via decomposition of POMDPs, improving performance by 3 and 5 orders of magnitude for instance size and runtime, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在不确定环境下智能体传感器选择问题，提出基于POMDP分解的新方法，将性能提升3-5个数量级。
AI.motivation: 在不确定域中部署传感器需要在任务可行性与硬件/处理成本之间取得平衡，现有方法因可扩展性差而难以解决实际问题。
AI.method: 通过POMDP分解识别合理的观测函数，并与基于参数合成的原始方法相结合，优化传感器选择问题(SSP)和位置可观测性问题(POP)的求解。
AI.result: 新方法在实例规模上提升3个数量级，在运行时间上提升5个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 基于POMDP分解的方法能有效扩展最优可观测性问题求解，为传感器选型提供可行的工程方案。
idea_en: A method for sensor selection in uncertain environments by decomposing Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) to identify optimal observation functions, achieving 3-5 orders of magnitude improvement in scalability.
A POMDP decomposition-based approach for solving the Sensor Selection Problem (SSP) that dramatically reduces computational complexity compared to parameter synthesis methods.
A positional observability optimization technique that determines optimal sensor placement in partially observable domains through symbolic decomposition of decision processes.
idea_ch: 一种通过分解部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程(POMDP)来识别最优观测函数的传感器选择方法，可扩展性提升3-5个数量级
一种基于POMDP分解的传感器选择问题(SSP)求解方法，相比参数合成方法大幅降低计算复杂度
一种位置可观测性优化技术，通过决策过程的符号化分解确定部分可观测域中的最优传感器部署位置

title: Epicure: Navigating the Emergent Geometry of Food Ingredient Embeddings
summary: We present Epicure, a family of three sibling skip-gram ingredient embeddings retrained from scratch on a multilingual recipe corpus. We aggregate 4.14M recipes from 11 sources spanning seven languages, English, Chinese, Russian, Vietnamese, Spanish, Turkish, Indonesian, German, and Indian-English, and normalise the raw ingredient strings to 1,790 canonical entries via an LLM-augmented pipeline. A 203,508-edge ingredient-ingredient NPMI graph and an 80,019-edge typed FlavorDB ingredient-compound graph, 2,247 typed compound nodes across 15 categories, seed three Metapath2Vec variants that share architecture and hyperparameters and differ only in the random-walk schema: Cooc walks the co-occurrence graph only, Chem walks the typed compound metapaths only, and Core blends both via injected ingredient-ingredient walks at controlled mixing, placing each model at a distinct point on the chemistry-vs-recipe-context spectrum.

AI.tldr: Epicure 是一个从多语言食谱语料库（4.14M 食谱，11 个来源，8 种语言）从头训练的 skip-gram 食材嵌入模型家族，包含三个变体（Cooc、Chem、Core），分别基于共现图、化学成分图和混合图进行元路径随机游走，以探索食材在食谱语境与化学特性之间的表示空间。
AI.motivation: 现有食材嵌入通常仅基于食谱共现信息，缺乏对食材化学成分的融合，限制了在跨语言、跨文化食谱分析中的表现。作者希望构建一个同时涵盖食谱语境与化学属性的多模态食材嵌入体系。
AI.method: 1) 收集 4.14M 多语言食谱并标准化为 1,790 个规范食材条目（LLM 增强管道）；2) 构建 203,508 边的食材-食材 NPMI 共现图和 80,019 边的 FlavorDB 食材-化合物类型图（2,247 类型化合物节点，15 类别）；3) 使用 Metapath2Vec 训练三个变体：Cooc（仅共现图）、Chem（仅化合物元路径）、Core（混合随机游走）。
AI.result: 成功训练出三个位于"化学-食谱语境"谱系不同位置的食材嵌入模型，能够同时捕捉食材的烹饪共现关系和化学组成特性。
AI.conclusion: Epicure 提供了一种可调节的食材表示框架，允许用户在食谱语境与化学属性之间权衡，为跨文化食谱检索、食材替换推荐、风味分析等应用提供基础。
idea_en: A multilingual recipe ingredient normalization pipeline augmented by large language model (LLM), capable of mapping raw ingredient strings from multiple languages (English, Chinese, Russian, Vietnamese, Spanish, Turkish, Indonesian, German, Indian-English) to a unified set of canonical entries.

A method for constructing typed ingredient-compound heterogeneous graph by integrating FlavorDB data, where compound nodes are categorized into 15 types, enabling metapath-based random walks that capture chemical relationships between ingredients.

A family of three Metapath2Vec-based ingredient embedding variants (Cooc, Chem, Core) that share architecture and hyperparameters but differ in random-walk schema, allowing controlled blending of co-occurrence and chemical information through injected ingredient-ingredient walks at controlled mixing ratios.
idea_ch: 一种由大语言模型（LLM）增强的多语言食谱食材标准化流水线，能够将来自多种语言的原始食材字符串映射到统一的规范条目集合。
一种通过整合 FlavorDB 数据构建类型化食材-化合物异构图的方法，化合物节点被分类为 15 个类型，支持基于元路径的随机游走以捕获食材之间的化学关系。
一个基于 Metapath2Vec 的三种食材嵌入变体家族（Cooc、Chem、Core），共享架构和超参数但随机游走模式不同，通过受控混合比例的注入式食材-食材游走实现共现信息与化学信息的可控融合。

title: S2ED: From Story to Executable Descriptions for Consistency-Aware Story Illustration
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted by IEEE ICME 2026
summary: Multi-frame story illustration requires long-horizon coherence beyond single-image text-to-image generation, including narrative decomposition and persistent character identity, layout, and affect across frames. We propose Story-to-Executable Descriptions (S2ED), a training-free, model-agnostic, prompt-layer framework that converts a full story into a sequence of explicit, editable executable descriptions for more consistent rendering. S2ED coordinates three agents to segment the narrative, ground canonical character attributes, and enrich spatial and affective cues, enabling interpretable prompt-carried state propagation and local edits to repair drift without retraining the generator. Experiments on Flintstones and Shakoo Maku show that S2ED improves sequence-level consistency and character fidelity over strong prompting, large-model planning, and a reference training-based method, under both automatic metrics and human judgments. We also deploy S2ED in an end-to-end story-to-storybook system for children's illustrated stories, with a supplementary video.

AI.tldr: S2ED是一个无需训练、模型无关的提示层框架，将完整故事转换为可执行描述序列，通过三个智能体协作实现多帧故事插图的长期连贯性，包括叙事分解、角色身份、布局和情感的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有单图像文本生成图像方法难以处理多帧故事插图所需的长期连贯性，包括叙事分解、角色身份、布局和情感的跨帧一致性。
AI.method: 提出S2ED框架，协调三个智能体（叙事分割、角色属性锚定、空间与情感线索丰富），将故事转换为可执行描述序列，支持提示层状态传播和局部编辑修复漂移，无需重新训练生成器。
AI.result: 在Flintstones和Shakoo Maku数据集上，S2ED在序列级一致性和角色保真度上优于强提示、大模型规划和基于参考训练的方法，自动指标和人工判断均支持。
AI.conclusion: S2ED是训练免费、模型无关的提示层框架，有效提升多帧故事插图的一致性和角色保真度，并已部署到端到端故事书生成系统中。
idea_en: A training-free, model-agnostic prompt-layer framework (S2ED) that converts full stories into executable description sequences for multi-frame coherent story illustration.
A multi-agent coordination mechanism for narrative segmentation, canonical character attribute grounding, and spatial/affective cue enrichment in story illustration.
Prompt-carried state propagation method enabling interpretable cross-frame consistency without retraining the generator.
Local edit mechanism within the prompt layer to repair drift and inconsistency across story frames.
End-to-end story-to-storybook system deploying S2ED for automated children's illustrated story generation.
idea_ch: 一种无需训练、模型无关的提示层框架(S2ED)，将完整故事转换为可执行描述序列，实现多帧故事插图的连贯渲染。
一种多智能体协同机制，用于叙事分割、规范角色属性锚定以及空间/情感线索丰富，提升故事插图一致性。
提示层状态传播方法，无需重新训练生成器即可实现跨帧可解释的一致性保持。
提示层局部编辑机制，用于修复故事帧间的漂移和不一致问题。
基于S2ED的端到端故事到故事书自动生成系统，应用于儿童插图故事创作。

title: KAPPS: A knowledge-based CPPS Architecture for the Circular Factory
comment: Submitted to Journal of Manufacturing Systems (JMS)
summary: While linear manufacturing relies on homogeneous materials and predefined process sequences, circular manufacturing reintroduces used products with heterogeneous and uncertain conditions. This shift demands manufacturing systems capable of handling variable product states, dynamically reconfigurable processes, and the integration of human and machine knowledge. Conventional manufacturing IT architectures, designed for stable structures and deterministic execution, are unable to meet these requirements, as they cannot adequately represent and manage the uniqueness of individual components at runtime. Following a design science methodology for developing a Cyber Physical Production System for circular manufacturing, we derive 14 requirements from five complementary perspectives. Based on these requirements, we design KAPPS, a knowledge-based architecture that uses an ontology-grounded knowledge graph as a unifying data backbone, combined with a semantic interface layer to enable consistent data and information integration, reasoning, and communication across heterogeneous systems and services, turning the knowledge graph from an integration layer into the factories authoritative write-time state. KAPPS incorporates modules for constraint enforcement and event-driven planning, enabling incremental adaptation of execution plans under uncertainty and human-machine knowledge exchange. The applicability of KAPPS is demonstrated through two implemented use cases: (i) Anomaly detection and learning through knowledge graph mediated services and (ii) runtime constraint enforcement in a modular conveyor system. Subsequently, the architecture is evaluated against the 14 requirements (ed. abstract shortened)

AI.tldr: 本文提出KAPPS架构，一种基于知识图谱的CPPS（信息物理生产系统），用于应对循环制造中产品状态异质、不确定带来的挑战，通过本体驱动的知识图谱作为统一数据骨干和语义接口层，实现数据集成、推理、通信及运行时约束执行与事件驱动规划，并通过两个用例验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 传统线性制造依赖同质材料和预定义流程，而循环制造需处理状态异质、不确定的回收产品。现有制造IT架构基于稳定结构和确定性执行，无法表示和管理单个组件的独特性，亟需新型架构支持动态重构过程及人机知识融合。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究方法论，从五个互补视角导出14项需求，设计KAPPS架构：以本体驱动的知识图谱作为统一数据骨干，结合语义接口层实现异构系统间的数据集成、推理与通信，将知识图谱转变为工厂权威的写时状态；包含约束执行与事件驱动规划模块，支持在不确定性下增量调整执行计划及人机知识交换。
AI.result: 通过两个用例验证：（i）基于知识图谱中介服务的异常检测与学习；（ii）模块化输送系统中的运行时约束执行。架构满足14项需求评估。
AI.conclusion: KAPPS架构有效解决了循环制造中数据集成、运行时适应性和人机知识交换等关键问题，为循环制造提供了可行的IT架构方案。

A semantic interface layer enabling consistent data and information integration, reasoning, and communication across heterogeneous manufacturing systems and services
Constraint enforcement module for runtime monitoring and enforcement of manufacturing constraints in circular production
Event-driven planning module enabling incremental adaptation of execution plans under uncertainty in manufacturing
Knowledge graph mediated anomaly detection and learning service for circular manufacturing systems
Runtime constraint enforcement system for modular conveyor systems in circular manufacturing
Method for turning knowledge graph from integration layer into factory's authoritative write-time state
System for human-machine knowledge exchange integrated with manufacturing knowledge graph
